spirals.zh_key: OENO: This sounds promising! Will you and your mentor investigate? If mining site 2b proves safe for this native species, we’ll move our work there.

spirals.speaker: CYCAD
spirals.text: Site 2b is safe! Coleus says we’ll continue to monitor our activity and its effect on life here.
spirals.zh: 赛卡德：2b是安全的！科利耶斯说我们会继续监控自己的活动，以及该活动对这里的生命所造成的影响。
spirals.zh_key: CYCAD: Site 2b is safe! Coleus says we’ll continue to monitor our activity and its effect on life here.

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: I was upstairs testing the Eye signal locator, and it can hear and follow the signals from the sun, Giant's Deep, and Brittle Hollow.
spirals.zh: 科利耶斯：我之前在楼上测试眼信号定位器，它能听见并追踪来自太阳、深巨星和碎空星的信号。

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: However, something strange is happening when I ask the Eye signal locator to follow the Eye's signal: The device's indicator rotates wildly and never points to just one direction.
spirals.zh: 科利耶斯：可是，当我让眼信号定位器追踪眼的信号时，发生了奇怪的事：装置的指示器会疯狂旋转，始终无法指向唯一的方向。

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: This is a curious result. It's possible the eye has stopped calling out its signal.
spirals.zh: 萨奇：这是个奇特的结果。也许眼已经停止呼唤了。

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: I see! I most likely calibrated the locator incorrectly. Privet (my apprentice) and I will make adjustments and try again.
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：我明白了！很可能是我没有正确校准定位器。普利维特（我的学徒）和我会进行调整，然后再次尝试。

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: An update: Disappointingly, everything is correctly calibrated after all.
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：更新：令人失望的是，一切其实都已经正确校准了。

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: It saddens me to posit this, my friends, but I believe we need to build a more sophisticated device if we want to find the exact location of the Eye of the universe.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：朋友们，很遗憾要提出这一点，但我认为，如果想找到宇宙之眼的确切位置，我们就需要建造一台更精密的装置。

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Then we will build it. Don't lose hope, Cassava; our search for the Eye is what brought our clan to this place. We won't give up so easily!
spirals.zh: 萨奇：那我们就造。不要失去希望，卡萨瓦；寻找眼是我们的族群来到这里的原因。我们不会这么轻易放弃！

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Where should this new, more sophisticated locator be built? It may need to be larger than this Eye signal locator is.
spirals.zh: 萨奇：这台更加复杂的新型定位器要建在哪里？占地规模可能得比眼信号定位器要大。
spirals.zh_key: THATCH: Where should this new, more sophisticated locator be built? It may need to be larger than this Eye signal locator is.

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: Annona and those of us originally stranded on the Ember Twin built a Quantum Moon locator there, but the heat of the sun made its construction challenging. I wouldn't recommend building on that planet.
spirals.zh: 科利耶斯：安诺纳还有我们一开始被困在余烬双星的人在那里造了一台量子卫星定位器，可是太阳的热辐射让工程变得十分艰难。我不建议在那颗行星上进行建造。
spirals.zh_key: COLEUS: Annona and those of us originally stranded on Ember Twin built a Quantum Moon locator there, but the heat of the sun made its construction challenging. I wouldn’t recommend building on that planet.

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: The southern glacier on Brittle Hollow has ample available space. I could construct a new building to house this proposed locator.
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：碎空星的南部冰川拥有充足的可用空间。我可以在那里新建一栋建筑来安置这台定位器。
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: The southern glacier on Brittle Hollow has ample available space. I could construct a new building to house this proposed locator.

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: Yes, let's build there! I imagine our young friend Conoy would enjoy that immensely. He's always had a great interest in the Eye, especially for a child born so long after the crash.
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：好的，就建在那里吧！我想我们年轻的朋友科诺伊一定会非常喜欢。作为一个坠机之后出生的孩子，他一向对眼兴趣盎然。
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: Yes, let’s build there! I imagine our young friend Conoy would enjoy that immensely. He’s always held a great interest in the Eye, especially for a child born so long after the crash.

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: I will begin construction on Brittle Hollow’s south pole immediately, then!
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：那么，我马上就去碎空星的南极开工！
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: I will begin construction on Brittle Hollow’s south pole immediately, then!

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Is everyone unharmed?
spirals.zh: 萨奇：所有人都没事吧？
spirals.zh_key: THATCH: Is everyone unharmed?

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: No one was badly injured from the escape pod's impact. We're incredibly fortunate.
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：没有人因为逃生舱的冲击而受重伤。我们真是太走运了。
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: No one was badly injured from the escape pod’s impact. We’re incredibly fortunate.

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: This is good news, at least. Have we heard from escape pod 2 or escape pod 3?
spirals.zh: 萨奇：至少这算是个好消息。我们有2号逃生舱或者3号逃生舱的消息吗？
spirals.zh_key: THATCH: This is good news, at least. Have we heard from Escape Pod 2 or Escape Pod 3?

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: No, I… I'm unable to make contact. My equipment can hear the other two escape pod's signals, though. If it's any comfort, both pods must be structurally intact.
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：没有，我……我无法进行联络。不过，我的设备可以收到其它两个逃生舱的求救信号。两个逃生舱的结构应该都完好无损。不知道这个消息对你是不是有帮助。
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: No, I... I’m unable to make contact. My equipment can hear the other two escape pods’ distress signals, however. If it’s any comfort, both pods must be structurally intact.

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: I'll continue calling for them.
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：我会继续呼叫他们。
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: I’ll continue calling for them.

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: My gratitude. If we can -
spirals.zh: 萨奇：感激不尽。如果我们可以……
spirals.zh_key: THATCH: My gratitude. If we can —

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: Thatch, the moon is approaching again!
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：萨奇，卫星又接近了！
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: Thatch, the moon is approaching again!

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Everyone brace yourselves, swiftly! The volcanic moon has returned!
spirals.zh: 萨奇：所有人做好准备，快！火山卫星回来了！
spirals.zh_key: THATCH: Everyone brace yourselves, swiftly! The volcanic moon has returned!

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Be cautious of falling ash and debris!
spirals.zh: 萨奇：当心掉下来的火山灰和岩屑！
spirals.zh_key: THATCH: Be cautious of falling ash and debris!

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: … I believe the moon has passed.
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：……我想卫星已经走了。
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: ...I believe the moon has passed.

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: This planet doesn't appear eager to have guests. We are certainly unwelcome on this planet.
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：这颗行星看来不是很好客。显然我们在它的地表上不受欢迎。
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: This planet doesn’t appear eager to have guests. We are certainly unwelcome on its surface.

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: We need to find shelter, and quickly. The volcanic moon won't be gone for long.
spirals.zh: 萨奇：我们得寻找庇护所，而且要快。那颗火山卫星很快就会再回来的。
spirals.zh_key: THATCH: We need to find shelter, and quickly. The volcanic moon won’t be gone for long.

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: I observed several promising sites below the surface, but we'll need to construct a way for everyone to climb safely down this cliff. Perhaps we could safely build platforms?
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：我在地下观察到几个可行的位置，不过我们得造一条路，让大家能够安全地从悬崖上爬下去。也许我们可以建造一些平台？
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: I observed several promising sites below the surface, but we’ll need to construct a way for everyone to climb safely down this cliff. Perhaps we could build platforms?

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: Use caution! A black hole sleeps below. You must not slip.
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：当心！下方沉睡着一个黑洞。千万不要失足。

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: Of note: Be sure not to wander far from here. Though this area is somewhat unstable, it's safer than any we've found so far.
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：注意：务必不要走远。这片区域虽有些不稳定，但仍是我们目前能找到最安全的地方。

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: The temporary settlement is finished, but remember to be cautious of falling rocks and dust caused by meteor impacts.
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：临时庇护所已经建好，但请记得留意撞击产生的落石和尘埃。

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: This knowledge is too dear to lose: Here is everything we recall about the signal we encountered while aboard the Vessel.
spirals.zh: 萨奇：这一知识十分关键，一定要保存下来：关于我们在飞船上收到的那个信号，我们所记得的情况都在这里。
spirals.zh_key: THATCH: This knowledge is too dear to lose: Here is everything we can recall about the signal we encountered while aboard the Vessel.

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: The signal looked like an eye: Round, with a circle at the centre much like a pupil. (Suppose the signal was looking for something.)
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：那个信号看上去像是一只眼睛，中央有个与瞳孔十分类似的圆形。（估计信号在寻找什么东西。）
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: The signal looked like an eye: round, with a circle at the center much like a pupil. (Suppose the signal was looking for something.)

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: The signal was older than the universe itself! This is the most significant detail.
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：那个信号比宇宙本身还要古老！这是最重要的细节。
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: The signal was older than the universe itself! This is the most significant detail.

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: No Nomai clan has ever encountered anything like it! How can anything in this universe be older than the universe itself?
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：以前从来没有哪个挪麦家族遇到过这样的东西！这个宇宙里怎么会有比宇宙本身还要古老的对象？
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: No Nomai clan has ever encountered anything like it! How can anything in this universe be older than the universe itself?

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Imagine what rare and profound knowledge it might offer. We *must* find this Eye of the universe.
spirals.zh: 萨奇：想想看，我们将会从它的身上了解到多么少有以及深远的知识。我们必须找到这个宇宙之眼。
spirals.zh_key: THATCH: Imagine what rare and profound knowledge it might offer. We must find this Eye of the universe.

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: I can't understand. Why did the Vessel crash in that place?
spirals.zh: 萨奇：我实在想不通。母舰为什么会坠毁在那个地方？

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: Was the Vessel unwell in some way?
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：母舰是不是哪儿出了毛病？

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: No, Annona and I checked before the warp, and the warp core and navigation systems were both well.
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：不，跃迁之前安诺纳和我做过检查，跃迁核心和导航系统都好着呢。

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: We warped to follow that curious signal from the eye of the universe. Where we arrived was wrong; it wasn't where we tried to go.
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：我们是跟着宇宙之眼发出的神秘信号进行跃迁的。然而，我们抵达的地点却完全错了——那根本不是我们原本想要前往的目的地。

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Suppose it wasn't a problem with the Vessel, but with our destination.
spirals.zh: 萨奇：假设不是母舰出了问题，而是我们的目的地出了问题。

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: I'm afraid for our friends in escape pod 3…
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：我很担心我们在3号逃生舱里的朋友们……

spirals.speaker: KOUSA
spirals.text: We can hear the other escape pod’s distress signals, which gives me hope. Foli, are you still here? I am unsure how to survive in this place without you.
spirals.zh: 库萨：我们可以听到其它逃生舱的求救信号，这给了我希望。弗利，你还在吗？真不知道没有你，我该怎么在这个地方活下去。
spirals.zh_key: KOUSA: We can hear the other escape pods’ distress signals, which gives me hope. Foli, are you still here? I am unsure how to survive in this place without you.

spirals.speaker: KOUSA
spirals.text: (I am unsure how to be me without you.)
spirals.zh: 库萨：（真不知道没有你我该怎么办。）
spirals.zh_key: KOUSA: (I am unsure how to be me without you.)

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: My brother wasn't in escape pod 1 with us. Was he in pod 2, or pod 3? Was he able to board an escape pod at all?
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：我的兄弟没有和我们一起登上1号逃生舱。他会不会在2号逃生舱，或是3号逃生舱里？他到底有没有登上逃生舱？
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: My brother wasn’t in Escape Pod 1 with us. Was he in Pod 2, or Pod 3? Was he able to board an escape pod at all?

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: We sacrificed too much arriving here. I cannot (I *will* not) allow our clan's greatest loss to be in vain.
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：为了能够来到这里，我们做出了太多牺牲。我们的家族蒙受了最为惨重的损失，我不能（我不会）无功而返。
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: We sacrificed too much arriving here. I cannot (I will not) allow our clan’s greatest loss to be in vain.

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Is the hardest part of this tragedy not knowing who we may have lost? Or will the hardest part come later, when we learn? (Be well, aunt Melorae...)
spirals.zh: 萨奇：难道说，这个方案最令人难以接受的部分，在于我们不知道将会失去谁？或是说最严峻的考验还在后头？（多保重，梅洛瑞姨妈……）
spirals.zh_key: THATCH: Is the hardest part of this tragedy not knowing who we may have lost? Or will the hardest part come later, when we learn? (Be well, Aunt Melorae...)

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: The pain of your absence is sharp and haunting, and I would give anything not to know it; anything but never knowing you at all (which would be worse).
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：你不在让我心如刀绞。如果能让我好过一些，我愿意付出一切代价。一切代价，除了无法与你相识（那样的话我会更加痛不欲生）。
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: The pain of your absence is sharp and haunting, and I would give anything not to know it; anything but never knowing you at all (which would be worse).

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: I can only hope that you are safe, Keek, wherever you are.
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：无论你在哪儿，奇克，我只希望你能够平安无事。
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: I can only hope that you are safe, Keek, wherever you are.

spirals.speaker: ILEX
spirals.text: Look out, look out below!
spirals.zh: 艾莱克斯：小心啊，小心啊！

spirals.speaker: ILEX
spirals.text: Look out for the gravity hole!
spirals.zh: 艾莱克斯：重力洞就在底下！

spirals.speaker: ILEX
spirals.text: For should you slip
spirals.zh: 艾莱克斯：要是不幸脚一滑

spirals.speaker: ILEX
spirals.text: And lose your grip,
spirals.zh: 艾莱克斯：手边又没地方抓

spirals.speaker: ILEX
spirals.text: Then into space you'll go!
spirals.zh: 艾莱克斯：太空就是你的家！

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: Given concerns about our settlements stability, where should we construct a new, less temporary shelter?
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：鉴于我们定居点的坚固程度，我们是不是应该建造一个比较长期的新庇护所？
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: Given concerns about our settlement’s stability, where should we construct a new, less temporary shelter?

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: We need to stay close to the escape pod so Filix can monitor incoming messages. We can't be rescued if we aren't present to respond.
spirals.zh: 萨奇：我们得待在逃生舱附近，这样费利克斯才能对传来的消息进行监控。如果我们不进行回应，那么别人就没法把我们救走。
spirals.zh_key: THATCH: We need to stay close to the escape pod so Filix can monitor incoming messages. We can’t be rescued if we aren’t present to respond.

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: I don't believe anyone is coming to save us, Thatch. Now we must save ourselves.
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：我觉得不会有人来救我们了，萨奇。现在我们必须靠自己才行。
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: I don’t believe anyone is coming to save us, Thatch. Now we must save ourselves.

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: I agree. We're here because the Eye's signal called to us and we followed. If we're to find it, we need to not merely survive, but thrive.
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：我同意。我们收到了眼的信号，跟着它才来到了这里。如果能够找到它，那么我们不但可以活下来，还能繁衍生息。
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: I agree. We’re here because the Eye’s signal called to us and we followed. If we’re to find it, we need to not merely survive, but thrive.

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: This is a wise point, Plume, and eloquently made. If moving to the Northern glacier will keep us safer, then that is what we should do.
spirals.zh: 萨奇：你的看法很明智，普鲁姆，而且无可辩驳。如果移动到北部冰川可以让我们更加安全，那我们就走吧。
spirals.zh_key: THATCH: This is a wise point, Plume, and eloquently made. If moving to the northern glacier will keep us safer, then that is what we should do.

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: I believe we should migrate to the North glacier.
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：我相信我们应该往北部冰川迁徙。
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: I believe we should migrate to the northern glacier.

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Building beneath the crust again would shelter us from the volcanic moon's eruptions.
spirals.zh: 萨奇：再次在地壳下方进行建造可以保护我们免除火山卫星喷发的危险。
spirals.zh_key: THATCH: Building beneath the crust again would shelter us from the volcanic moon’s eruptions.

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: What if we used gravity crystals to craft a stable path?
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：我们用重力水晶制造一条稳定的道路如何？
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: What if we use gravity crystals to craft a stable path?

spirals.speaker: LAMI
spirals.text: Explanation of Festivals
spirals.zh: 拉米：关于节日的解释

spirals.speaker: LAMI
spirals.text: All the Nomai clans from all over the universe meet in one place to share what they've learned in science and art. It's called the festival!
spirals.zh: 拉米：全宇宙所有的挪麦氏族都会齐聚一处，分享大家在科学与艺术上的发现。这就是“节日”！

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: Don't forget, festivals happen every ten years!
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：别忘了，节日每十年举办一次哦！

spirals.speaker: LAMI
spirals.text: We can't go because we're stuck here. But Filix says we used to go, too.
spirals.zh: 拉米：我们被困在这儿了，所以没法参加。但费利克斯说我们以前也会去的。

spirals.speaker: LAMI
spirals.text: At some festivals, one clan's big discovery can mean all the Nomai get to advance, too. Like Annona's warp core, which made it so everyone can warp long distances and explore more.
spirals.zh: 拉米：在某几届节日里，一个氏族的重大发现，也就意味着全体挪麦的进步。比如说安诺纳的跃迁核心，它让大家能够跃迁到更远的距离，进行更全面的探索。

spirals.speaker: LAMI
spirals.text: Each clan has a festival envoy to show their most interesting work. (Our envoy was Thatch!)
spirals.zh: 拉米：每个氏族都会派出一位“节日特使”，负责展示各自最有趣的成果。（我们氏族的特使是萨奇！）

spirals.speaker: LAMI
spirals.text: A single festival could last a long, long time!
spirals.zh: 拉米：一届节日可以持续很长、很长的时间！

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: Formation of This Universe
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：这个宇宙的形成

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: No one knows how this universe was made, but one thing we do know is everything used to be very hot and dense (tightly packed together).
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：没人知道这个宇宙是如何诞生的，但有一件事我们可以确定，那就是从前一切都非常炽热、非常致密（紧紧地挤压在一起）。

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: As this early universe expanded, it also cooled down. Once it had cooled down enough, particles were able to group together and form things like galaxies, stars and planets!
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：当这个早期宇宙膨胀的时候，它也在逐渐冷却。一旦温度降得足够低，粒子便开始聚集，形成了星系、恒星和行星这样的东西！

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: Since then, space has continued to grow at a faster and faster rate, which is hard to think about without your brain hurting.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：那之后，太空还在不停地膨胀，速度越来越快，让人琢磨久了还会脑瓜子疼。

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: This universe will keep getting colder and larger, until one day, the stars and the life they support will all die.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：这个宇宙还会继续变得越来越冷，越来越大，直到有一天，所有的星星，以及它们所孕育的生命，都会统统死亡。

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: That's scary to think about, even though Conoy tells me it won't happen in our lifetimes. But it'll happen in someone else's, someday!
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：虽然科诺伊告诉我说，我们这辈子不会面临这样的事情，可是想想还是很吓人。而且总有一天，别人会迎来这一天！

spirals.speaker: ILEX
spirals.text: Why We Should Build A New Vessel
spirals.zh: 艾莱克斯：我们为什么要建造一艘新的飞船
spirals.zh_key: ILEX: Why We Should Build A New Vessel

spirals.speaker: ILEX
spirals.text: Each Nomai clan explores the universe in its own Vessel. The Vessel is in the heart of every clan.
spirals.zh: 艾莱克斯：所有挪麦家族都会乘坐自己的飞船来探索宇宙。飞船是每一个家族的核心。
spirals.zh_key: ILEX: Each Nomai clan explores the universe in its own Vessel. The Vessel is the heart of every clan.

spirals.speaker: ILEX
spirals.text: It's unusual for Nomai to remain in one place for so long. Nomai are wanderers and have no permanent home.
spirals.zh: 艾莱克斯：挪麦人在一个地方逗留这么长时间是很不寻常的。挪麦人都是漫游者，居无定所。
spirals.zh_key: ILEX: It’s unusual for Nomai to remain in one place for so long. Nomai are wanderers and have no permanent home.

spirals.speaker: ILEX
spirals.text: If we built a new Vessel we could return to our adventurous way of life. Imagine all the new places we could go! Our clan wouldn't be stuck here in this star system.
spirals.zh: 艾莱克斯：如果我们建造一艘新的飞船，就可以重归冒险生活。想想看，我们将会前往哪些新的地方！我们的家族是不会被困在在这个星系里的。
spirals.zh_key: ILEX: If we built a new Vessel, we could return to our adventurous way of life. Imagine all the new places we could go! Our clan wouldn’t be stuck here in this star system.

spirals.speaker: ILEX
spirals.text: We could even meet with other Nomai, and learn from them, like Coleus says we used to do.
spirals.zh: 艾莱克斯：我们还能和其他挪麦人见面，学习他们掌握的知识。我们以前就是这样做的，就像科利耶斯说得那样。
spirals.zh_key: ILEX: We could even meet with other Nomai, and learn from them, like Coleus says we used to do.

spirals.speaker: ILEX
spirals.text: It probably wouldn't be hard to get parts if we stopped building other new things, and if we broke down other structures (like the towers on Ash Twin) for parts.
spirals.zh: 艾莱克斯：假如我们别再建造其它的新东西，并且把其它建筑拆掉（比如灰烬双星上的那些高塔），说不定就不愁弄不到零件了。
spirals.zh_key: ILEX: It probably wouldn’t be hard to get parts if we stopped building other new things, and if we broke down other structures (like the towers on Ash Twin) for parts.

spirals.speaker: ILEX
spirals.text: We could even have a warp core for jumping long distances like Vessels have. Poke tells me she plans to make a very advanced warp core for a different project. I'm sure she could connect it to the Vessel for travel (because Poke is smart).
spirals.zh: 艾莱克斯：我们还有一颗可以进行远距离跳跃的跃迁核心，就像飞船上的核心那样。珀克告诉我，她打算为其它计划制造一颗非常高级的跃迁核心。我肯定她可以把核心和飞船进行连接，用它来航行（因为珀克很聪明）。
spirals.zh_key: ILEX: We could even have a warp core for jumping long distances like Vessels have. Poke tells me she plans to make a very advanced warp core for a different project. I’m sure she could connect it to the Vessel for travel (because Poke is smart).

spirals.speaker: ILEX
spirals.text: We might have to build a smaller Vessel for now, even though Vessels are normally large. But we could make it bigger later once we reach planets with more resources.
spirals.zh: 艾莱克斯：我们目前也许只能建造一艘小一点的飞船。虽然一般来说飞船都很大。但是我们可以在抵达其它资源更多的行星时，再把飞船造得更大。
spirals.zh_key: ILEX: We might have to build a smaller Vessel for now, even though Vessels are normally large. But we could make it bigger later once we reach planets with more resources.

spirals.speaker: ILEX
spirals.text: It would also help if we stopped building so many things to search for the Eye of the universe. I asked Yarrow, and he says we use lots of resources on the Ash Twin Project.
spirals.zh: 艾莱克斯：如果我们不再造那么多东西去寻找宇宙之眼就好了。我问过亚罗，他说我们在灰烬双星计划上投入了许多资源。
spirals.zh_key: ILEX: It would also help if we stopped building so many things to search for the Eye of the universe. I asked Yarrow, and he says we use lots of resources on the Ash Twin Project.

spirals.text: The Ash Twin Project requires a powerful, highly advanced warp core. How should we obtain it?
spirals.zh: 灰烬双星计划需要一个强大、非常高级的跃迁核心。我们如何获得它？

spirals.text: Solution 1: We could retrieve the warp core from the Vessel.
spirals.zh: 解决方案1：我们可以从飞船上面把跃迁核心回收回来。
spirals.zh_key: Solution 1: We could retrieve the warp core from the Vessel.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: The Vessel’s warp core is broken, at best (recall those present when the Vessel crashed said it sustained lethal injuries). There is no guaranteed reward for this risk.
spirals.zh: 瑞米：乐观估计，飞船的跃迁核心已经坏了（回想飞船坠落当时所提到的，核心受到了致命的损伤）。这次冒险未必能够得到回报。
spirals.zh_key: RAMIE: The Vessel’s warp core is broken, at best (recall those present when the Vessel crashed said it sustained lethal injuries). There is no guaranteed reward for this risk.

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: Even if it no longer functions, the old core would be a valuable blueprint, provided we're able to transport it back here.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：就算旧核心已经无法工作了，只要我们能够把它给运回来，它依然可以为我们提供宝贵的设计蓝图。
spirals.zh_key: CASSAVA: Even if it no longer functions, the old core could be a valuable blueprint, provided we’re able to transport it back here.

spirals.speaker: CONOY
spirals.text: Perhaps we could still repair it. My grandmother told me there was little time to assess the nature or extent of the damage.
spirals.zh: 科诺伊：也许我们依然应该把它修好。我的祖母告诉过我，没有时间可以去评估损失的性质或者是程度。
spirals.zh_key: CONOY: Perhaps we could still repair it. My grandmother told me there was little time to assess the nature or extent of the damage.

spirals.speaker: PHLOX
spirals.text: This would require a return to Dark Bramble. Plume (my father) said many a good Nomai perished there.
spirals.zh: 弗拉克斯：这样我们就得回到黑棘星去。普鲁姆（我的父亲）说过，许多出色的挪麦人都在那里失去了生命。
spirals.zh_key: PHLOX: This would require a return to Dark Bramble. Plume (my father) said many good Nomai perished there.

spirals.speaker: CYCAD
spirals.text: My mentor (Coleus) and his old mentor once discovered and studied an anglerfish fossil on Ember Twin. Using that knowledge, we could avoid the anglerfish entirely!
spirals.zh: 赛卡德：我的导师（科利耶斯）和他从前的导师有一次在余烬双星上发现过一块安康鱼化石，并对其进行了研究。通过这些知识，我们完全可以避开安康鱼！
spirals.zh_key: CYCAD: My mentor (Coleus) and his old mentor once discovered and studied an anglerfish fossil on Ember Twin. Using that knowledge, we could avoid the anglerfish entirely!

spirals.speaker: COLEUS
spirals.text: What Melorae and I learned from that fossil would theoretically help us evade the anglerfish, but my hypothesis was never tested on a live specimen.
spirals.zh: 科利耶斯：从理论上来讲，梅洛瑞和我从化石上了解到的内容可以帮助我们躲避安康鱼，但我们的假设从来没有在活体标本上进行过验证。
spirals.zh_key: COLEUS: What Melorae and I learned from that fossil would theoretically help us evade the anglerfish, but our hypothesis was never tested on a live specimen.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: I remember that anglerfish fossil! We used to play in Fossil Fish Cave when we were children.
spirals.zh: 瑞米：我记得那块安康鱼化石！我们小的时候曾经在化石鱼洞里面玩过游戏。
spirals.zh_key: RAMIE: I remember that anglerfish fossil! We used to play in Fossil Fish Cave when we were children.

spirals.text: Solution 2: We could craft a new advanced warp core inspired by the Vessel’s warp core.
spirals.zh: 方案2：我们以母舰的跃迁核心为灵感，打造一个新的高级跃迁核心。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: I would very much like to craft such a powerful core! More relevantly, I believe the Black Hole Forge crew and I could recreate the basic design.
spirals.zh: 珀克：我非常想亲手制造这样一个强大的核心！更重要的是，我相信黑洞熔炉的团队和我能够重现基本设计。

spirals.speaker: SPIRE
spirals.text: Abandoning the Vessel's warp core and its casing means losing valuable knowledge.
spirals.zh: 斯拜尔：放弃母舰的跃迁核心及其外壳，意味着我们将会失去许多宝贵的知识。

spirals.speaker: MITIS
spirals.text: This is true; however, it's knowledge we have little hope of recovering. It would be best to relearn, I think.
spirals.zh: 迈泰斯：确实如此，但这毕竟是我们几乎无望复得的知识。依我看，最好的办法还是从头学起。

spirals.speaker: IDAEA
spirals.text: This is the safest path for our clan.
spirals.zh: 伊代亚：这对我们氏族而言，无疑是最稳妥的一条路。

spirals.speaker: AVENS
spirals.text: Is the safest path the best one? Our goal is worth the risk.
spirals.zh: 埃文斯：最稳妥的路就一定是最好的路吗？为了实现我们的目标，冒些风险是值得的。

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: Is it, though? We've tried for so long to find something that I (and others) now believe might be impossible to find. If the search for the Eye is a futile one, we should choose the option with the least potential for harm.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：真的值得吗？我们苦苦寻找了这么久，而我（还有一些同伴）现在已经开始相信也许根本不可能找到。如果寻找眼的行动注定徒劳，我们就应该选择伤害最小的那条路。

spirals.speaker: OENO
spirals.text: The greatest challenge here, I think, is we don't have the original for such a powerful core, or any of the original crafters of the Vessel's core.
spirals.zh: 奥埃诺：我认为，目前最大的困难在于：我们既没有那枚强大核心的图纸可供参照，也找不回当初制造母舰跃迁核心的那批人了。

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: No, but Poke was apprenticed to Annona, who created the original design, and our Black Hole Forge is adept at crafting similar cores.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：确实没有，但珀克的导师曾是安诺纳——跃迁核心的原始设计者。况且我们的黑洞熔炉很擅长制造简单的跃迁核心。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: I believe I could be of use here! The Vessel’s warp core was created before my time, but Annona explained many of his designs to me.
spirals.zh: 珀克：我相信我能派上用场！母舰的跃迁核心在我出生以前就有了，但安诺纳向我讲解过他的许多设计思路。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: I feel strange, trying to recreate Annona's warp core without him. At times, it feels strange to no longer be his (very young) apprentice, and for the Black Hole Forge to be in my care and not his.
spirals.zh: 珀克：要试着在没有安诺纳的情况下复原他的跃迁核心，这让我感觉很奇怪。我已不再是他的（非常年轻的）学徒了，主持黑洞熔炉的人如今成了我而非他——这一切仍然让我感到陌生。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Hypothesis: This will always feel strange. Even though my time with him was short, I will always miss my old mentor, and deeply.
spirals.zh: 珀克：假设：这种感觉将永远伴随着我。尽管与他相处的时间不长，我却深深思念着这位曾经的导师。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: To have the chance to try is thrilling, but… I don't want to disappoint everyone. I *think* I can do this (probably), but what if excitement has clouded my assessment of my own abilities?
spirals.zh: 珀克：能有机会去尝试这项任务令我感到无比振奋，但是……我不想让大家失望。我觉得自己（大概）能做到，可万一是兴奋蒙蔽了我对自身能力的判断呢？

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Was I wrong in volunteering to build it...? I was born in this spare system, and never saw Annona's warp core with my own three eyes. I only know what he taught me. What if I've bitten off a larger portion than I can consume?
spirals.zh: 珀克：我是不是不该自告奋勇建造核心……？我出生在这个星系，从未用我自己的三只眼见过安诺纳的跃迁核心。我只知道他教给我的那些。万一是我贪多嚼不烂呢？

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Still, all I can give is my best. And as Annona would say, should my best prove insufficient, then we will find another way to achieve what's needed. I have Clary and Root in the forge, and I have my clan. I am not alone!
spirals.zh: 珀克：无论如何，我只能全力以赴。就像安诺纳常说的——如果我的全力仍然不够，我们就会另寻他法来达成目标。熔炉里，我有克莱瑞和鲁特；熔炉外，我还有我的氏族。我不是一个人！

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: I imagine I've been hard on Poke, again. This in turn means I've made things difficult for her sister (Clary).
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：我想我又对珀克太苛刻了。也就是说，我让克莱瑞（她的姐妹）为难了。

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: If Poke and I are oil and water, Clary is our emulsifier. She certainly makes us a better team than would mixing through shaking (although sometimes I would like to shake Poke!)
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：如果珀克和我就像油水互不相容，那克莱瑞就是我们的乳化剂。有了她，我们的配合远比靠摇晃混合要强（尽管有时候我真想狠狠摇一摇珀克！）。

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: Jokes aside, suppose my own fear of never finding the Eye prompted my argument with Poke. That would be immature of me.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：玩笑归玩笑，设若是我内心那种永远找不到眼的恐惧，才导致了和珀克的争执。我的表现也未免太不成熟了。

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: I should apologise… at least to Clary, who could then tell Poke.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：我应该去道个歉……至少向克莱瑞道歉，再由她转告给珀克。

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: I no longer believe, as I did as a child on Ember Twin, that the Eye of the universe (the source of the signal) wishes to harm us. But it may not want to be found, either.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：小时候在余烬双星上，我一直认为宇宙之眼（那个信号的源头）想要害我们。现在我已经改变了这个想法。不过也许它也不希望被别人找到。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: I no longer believe, as I did as a child on Ember Twin, that the Eye of the universe (the source of the signal) wishes to harm us. But it may not want to be found, either.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: In fact, the Eye may not have wishes at all. We have no evidence supporting this.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：事实上，眼很可能根本没有自己的意愿。我们并不具备支持这一说法的证据。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: In fact, the Eye may not have wishes at all. We have no evidence supporting this.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: The terrible circumstances of our arrival here were almost certainly exactly that: Circumstance.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：我们来到这里所遭遇的艰苦环境几乎就说明了这一点。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: The terrible circumstances of our arrival here were almost certainly exactly that: circumstance.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: I suspect imagining we are special to the eye in some way is wishful thinking. The Eye might have called out to any sentient species.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：我们觉得自己对于眼来说是特别的存在。我猜测这种想法不过是一厢情愿。眼可能在对任何一个智能物种发出呼唤。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: I suspect imagining we are special to the Eye in some way is wishful thinking. The Eye might have called out to any sentient species.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: Or it might not have been calling out at all, and that my ancestors heard the Eye's signal holds no great, deep meaning.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：也可能它根本没有在进行呼唤，我的祖先听到的眼信号并没有什么深刻的含义。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: Or it might not have been calling out at all, and that my ancestors heard the Eye’s signal holds no great, deep meaning.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: This wouldn't be so bad, I think.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：我想，这也不算是什么坏事。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: This wouldn’t be so bad, I think.

spirals.text: Be welcomed in this place. This shrine is a space to reflect on what brought us here to this star system: The signal from the Eye.
spirals.zh: 欢迎来到这个地方。来自眼的信号把我们带到了这个星系。我们在这个祭坛里对这一现象进行思考。
spirals.zh_key: Be welcomed in this place. This shrine is a space to reflect on what brought us to this star system: the signal from the Eye.

spirals.text: We observed the Eye's signal in our travels, and followed it here to find its source.
spirals.zh: 我们在旅途中观察到了眼的信号，于是跟着它来到这里，想要寻找信号的来源。
spirals.zh_key: We observed the Eye’s signal in our travels, and followed it here to find its source.

spirals.text: What we know is this: The source of the signal (which we have chosen to call the Eye of the universe) is older than the universe itself. The rest, we have yet to learn.
spirals.zh: 我们所知的情况如下：信号的来源（我们称之为宇宙之眼）比这个宇宙本身还要古老。别的我们就不知道了。
spirals.zh_key: What we know is this: The source of the signal (which we have chosen to call the Eye of the universe) is older than this universe itself. The rest, we have yet to learn.

spirals.text: Enter, and open your mind to its possibilities.
spirals.zh: 进入祭坛，在它的各种可能性面前，开放你的头脑。
spirals.zh_key: Enter, and open your mind to its possibilities.

spirals.text: What is the Eye of the universe?
spirals.zh: 什么是宇宙之眼？
spirals.zh_key: What is the Eye of the universe?

spirals.text: The Eye is the source of the signal that brought us here.
spirals.zh: 是眼发出的信号带我们来到了这里。
spirals.zh_key: The Eye is the source of the signal that brought us here.

spirals.text: Suppose the Eye is a more advanced being.
spirals.zh: 估计眼是一个更加高级的存在。
spirals.zh_key: Suppose the Eye is a more advanced being.

spirals.text: The Eye is older than the universe, so imagine how much it could teach us.
spirals.zh: 眼比这个宇宙本身还要古老。想想看，我们能从它那里学到多少知识。
spirals.zh_key: The Eye is older than this universe, so imagine how much it could teach us.

spirals.text: Perhaps it is a cosmic library!
spirals.zh: 说不定它就是一座宇宙图书馆！
spirals.zh_key: Perhaps it is a cosmic library!

spirals.text: How can the Eye be older than the universe itself?
spirals.zh: 眼怎么可能比宇宙本身还要古老？

spirals.text: Suppose it is a relic from a previous universe.
spirals.zh: 假设它是来自前一个宇宙的遗物。

spirals.text: The early universe was unimaginably hot and dense. If anything existed before, it would have been destroyed.
spirals.zh: 早期宇宙的温度和密度难以想象。若那时已有任何存在，早就被摧毁了。

spirals.text: Suppose the universe is older than previously assumed.
spirals.zh: 假设宇宙比我们此前所认为的更为古老。

spirals.text: What sets the eyes signal?
spirals.zh: 眼的信号到底是什么？
spirals.zh_key: What is the Eye’s signal?

spirals.text: Of note: From the signal, we were able to determine the Eye’s approximate age (or perhaps its lack of age?)
spirals.zh: 注意事项：我们根据信号可以推断出眼的大致年龄（或者应该说，它缺少的那部分年龄？）。
spirals.zh_key: Of note: From the signal, we were able to determine the Eye’s approximate age (or perhaps its lack of age?).

spirals.text: Suppose the Eye wishes to communicate.
spirals.zh: 估计眼想要进行交流。
spirals.zh_key: Suppose the Eye wishes to communicate.

spirals.text: The signal is a call. Were we the intended audience?
spirals.zh: 那个信号在进行呼唤。是在呼唤我们吗？
spirals.zh_key: The signal is a call. Were we the intended audience?

spirals.text: The signal is the Eye's voice. It speaks a language we don't yet know.
spirals.zh: 那个信号是眼在说话。它说着我们尚且无法理解的语言。
spirals.zh_key: The signal is the Eye’s voice. It speaks a language we don’t yet know.

spirals.text: Or maybe the signal is the Eye's attempt at expressing itself.
spirals.zh: 或许那个信号是眼想要表达自己。
spirals.zh_key: Or maybe the signal is the Eye’s attempt at expressing itself.

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Clary and Root, kindly tune the alignments on each black hole core as I finish them. The schematic on the floor shows which warp tower aligns with which astral body.
spirals.zh: 珀克：克莱瑞还有鲁特，请在我完成黑洞核心的时候，对每一颗核心进行校准调节。哪座跃迁塔和哪个天体匹配，都画在地上的图示里了。
spirals.zh_key: POKE: Clary and Root, kindly tune the alignments on each black hole core as I finish them. The schematic on the floor shows which warp tower aligns with which astral body.

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: To speed future deliveries to Ash Twin, I've tuned the first black hole core to activate when it's warp tower aligns along with Brittle Hollow.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：为了以后能更快捷地到达灰烬双星，我已经调整好了第一颗黑洞核心，把它设为在跃迁塔对准碎空星时启动。
spirals.zh_key: CLARY: To speed future deliveries to Ash Twin, I’ve tuned the first black hole core to activate when its warp tower aligns with Brittle Hollow.

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: And before anyone comments, *yes*, I am aware this reduces the distance between Yarrow and me.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：不用你们说，没错，我注意到了：如此一来，亚罗和我之间的距离将会大大缩减。
spirals.zh_key: CLARY: And before anyone comments, yes, I am aware this reduces the distance between Yarrow and me.

spirals.speaker: ROOT
spirals.text: This schematic shows the six towers on Ash Twin being tuned to only five alignments. Is that a mistake?
spirals.zh: 鲁特：根据图示，灰烬双星的六座跃迁塔只匹配了五个天体。是哪里出错了吗？
spirals.zh_key: ROOT: The schematic shows the six towers on Ash Twin are being tuned to only five alignments. Is that a mistake?

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: No, that's correct. For these alignments we've decided to treat the Hourglass Twins as a single astral body.
spirals.zh: 珀克：不，没有错。匹配跃迁塔时，我们得把沙漏双星看作一个天体。
spirals.zh_key: POKE: No, that’s correct. For these alignments we've decided to treat the Hourglass Twins as a single astral body.

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: If it helps, you can imagine the Hourglass Twins as aligning with themselves.
spirals.zh: 珀克：你可以这样理解，沙漏双星之间算是相互匹配的。
spirals.zh_key: POKE: If it helps, you can imagine the Hourglass Twins as aligning with themselves.

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Have you seen Phlox's tower designs in the High Energy Lab on Ember Twin? They clarify each tower's warp destination.
spirals.zh: 珀克：你有没有去余烬双星上的高能实验室看过弗拉克斯的跃迁塔设计图？每座塔的跃迁目的地都已经标明在上面了。
spirals.zh_key: POKE: Have you seen Phlox’s tower designs in the High Energy Lab on Ember Twin? They clarify each tower’s warp destination.

spirals.speaker: ROOT
spirals.text: Where am I taking this first black hole core? (And where am I taking the remaining cores once they're ready?)
spirals.zh: 鲁特：我要把这第一个黑洞核心送到哪里？（剩下的核心准备好以后，我又该把它们送到哪里？）

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: The white hole cores are for the six warp receivers. Each warp tower leads to a different planet, so that will be a greater pain in your cervical spine (Yarrow knows the exact locations).
spirals.zh: 珀克：白洞核心是给跃迁接收点准备的。六个接收点都建在不同的位置，这下你颈椎该疼得厉害了。
spirals.zh_key: POKE: The white hole cores are for the warp receivers. Each of the six receivers are being constructed at different locations, so those deliveries will be a greater pain in your cervical spine.

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: All of the warp towers are being constructed on Ash Twin, so the black hole cores will go there.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：所有跃迁塔都在灰烬双星上建造，所以黑洞核心都送去那里。

spirals.speaker: ROOT
spirals.text: My gratitude! In that case: Poke, Clary, I'm leaving for delivery! I'll send Yarrow your regards.
spirals.zh: 鲁特：感激不尽！既然如此：珀克，克莱瑞，我出发送货了！我会把你们的问候带给亚罗。

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Poke, I'll return to the forge shortly; I'm going to catch up to Root and help him deliver the first core to Ash Twin, just to make sure Yarrow receives it.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：珀克，我很快就回熔炉；我要追上鲁特，帮他把第一个核心送到灰烬双星，只是为了确保亚罗收到它。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Of course you are.
spirals.zh: 珀克：你当然要去。

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: I have good news, Yarrow! The advanced warp core is ready to be installed at the heart of the Ash Twin Project.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：我有好消息，亚罗！高级跃迁核心已经准备好安装到灰烬双星的中央舱室里了。

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: I'm intrigued, love! Everyone here working on the Ash Twin Project is excited to see it (Pye is beside herself with joy!).
spirals.zh: 亚罗：我非常感兴趣，亲爱的！参与灰烬双星计划的所有人都迫不及待了（派伊高兴得不得了！）。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: No, it isn't!
spirals.zh: 珀克：不，还没好！

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Is everything well at the forge?
spirals.zh: 亚罗：熔炉那边一切都好吗？

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Don't worry, love; Poke is only nervous. The core is extraordinary, and her design work is beautifully clever.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：别担心，亲爱的；珀克只是紧张。这个核心非同凡响，她的设计工作也漂亮又巧妙。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: The core’s durability could still be improved! I need more time!
spirals.zh: 珀克：核心的耐久性还有提升空间！我需要更多时间！

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Ignore her, Yarrow. The core is finished. And if my sister tells you otherwise, then *she* will be finished, as well.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：别理她，亚罗。核心已经完成了。如果我的姐妹告诉你不是这样，那她也要完了。

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: Has anyone observed the phantom moon that sometimes greets us in the night sky? Your thoughts interest me.
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：有谁观察过偶尔在夜空中露面的幻影卫星？我愿意听一听你们的想法。
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: Has anyone observed the phantom moon that sometimes greets us in the night sky? Your thoughts interest me.

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: I compliment your eyes! How do you imagine it disappears? Hypothesis: Could it be a shift in the light spectrum?
spirals.zh: 萨奇：你的眼神可真是厉害！你对它的消失怎么认为？假设：会不会是光谱偏移导致的？
spirals.zh_key: THATCH: I compliment your eyes! How do you imagine it disappears? Hypothesis: Could it be a shift in the light spectrum?

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: Suppose this moon is too shy to show us its face.
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：估计这颗卫星太害羞，不敢把自己的脸露出来。
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: Suppose this moon is too shy to show us its face.

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: I'm interested in your playful moon. Is it much like it's violent friend (Hollow’s Lantern)?
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：我对这颗调皮的卫星很感兴趣。它像不像它的那颗颜色鲜艳的朋友（空心灯）？
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: I’m interested in your playful moon. Is it much like its violent friend (Hollow’s Lantern)?

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: This moon isn’t volcanic (to my unaided eyes). Sometimes it leaves its friend Hollow’s Lantern for nights at a time.
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：这不是一颗火山卫星（在我的肉眼看来）。有时它会一下子把它的朋友空心灯丢下，长达好几个晚上。
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: This moon isn’t volcanic (to my unaided eyes). Sometimes it leaves its friend Hollow’s Lantern for nights at a time.

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: The nights the moon circles this planet appear random. It seems to travel as it likes.
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：卫星貌似是随机出现在这颗行星的夜空中的。好像它想去哪儿就去哪儿。
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: The nights the moon circles this planet appear random. It seems to travel as it likes.

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Imagine if there were *two* volcanic moons.
spirals.zh: 萨奇：想想看，万一它们是2颗火山卫星呢？
spirals.zh_key: THATCH: Imagine if there were two volcanic moons.

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: Then I imagine there'd be none of us left!
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：那我想咱们就都活不成了！
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: Then I imagine there’d be none of us left!

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: Hypothesis: There can exist too much lava.
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：假设：上面可能会有过多的岩浆。
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: Hypothesis: There can exist too much lava.

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: I'd strongly prefer we test the null hypothesis.
spirals.zh: 萨奇：我强烈建议我们证明一下这种假设是错误的。
spirals.zh_key: THATCH: I’d strongly prefer we test the null hypothesis.

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: To our friends on Brittle Hollow: I just warped here from the White Hole Station (on the other side of Brittle Hollow’s black hole)! Our design worked; we've successfully recreated warp travel!
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：给我们在碎空星上的朋友们：我刚刚从白洞站（碎空星黑洞的另一头）跃迁到了这里！我们的设计方案起作用了；我们成功地再现了跃迁旅行！
spirals.zh_key: CLARY: To our friends on Brittle Hollow: I just warped here from the White Hole Station (on the other side of Brittle Hollow’s black hole)! Our design worked; we’ve successfully recreated warp travel!

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: This is wonderful news! I can't wait to see the warp tower (although it's been a long time since I've jumped through a black hole!
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：这真是天大的好消息！我迫不及待地想要看看跃迁塔的样子（虽然我上次穿越黑洞已经是很久以前的事情了！）。
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: This is wonderful news! I can’t wait to see the warp tower (although it’s been a long time since I’ve jumped through a black hole!).

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: I don't know how close I was to Annona's original design, but as long as what we've built works, then I'm delighted! I knew we could do it (Cassava, I hope you're reading this)!
spirals.zh: 珀克：我不知道它和安诺纳的原版设计有多大的差别，不过只要能管用，那我就很高兴！我就知道我们能成功（卡萨瓦，但愿你正在看）！
spirals.zh_key: POKE: I don’t know how close it is to Annona’s original design, but as long as what we’ve built works, then I’m delighted! I knew we could do it (Cassava, I hope you’re reading this)!

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Wait, this can't be correct. Clary, have you seen these readings? If they were accurate, they would violate causality. There must be an equipment error somewhere.
spirals.zh: 珀克：等等，这不可能。克莱瑞，你看到这些读数了吗？如果读数正确，那么它们就违反了因果律。一定是有什么地方的设备出现了问题。
spirals.zh_key: POKE: Wait, this can’t be correct. Clary, have you seen these readings? If they were accurate, they would violate causality. There must be an equipment error somewhere.

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: I'm returning to the White Hole Station. If you and Root meet me there, we can run a full diagnostic and hopefully locate the problem.
spirals.zh: 珀克：我正在返回白洞站。如果你和鲁特去那里找我，我们可以进行一次全面诊断，希望能够把问题给找出来。
spirals.zh_key: POKE: I’m returning to the White Hole Station. If you and Root meet me there, we can run a full diagnostic and hopefully locate the problem.

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: (don't tell Cassava.)
spirals.zh: 珀克：（别告诉卡萨瓦。）
spirals.zh_key: POKE: (Don’t tell Cassava.)

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Ramie and I reviewed the records you sent, Poke, and they appear to show the Nomai are arriving at the warp receiver on Brittle Hollow slightly *before* departing from the White Hole Station.
spirals.zh: 派伊：瑞米和我查看了你送来的记录，珀克，貌似挪麦人抵达碎空星跃迁接收点的时间比离开白洞站的时间要稍微早那么一点点。
spirals.zh_key: PYE: Ramie and I reviewed the records you sent, Poke, and they appear to show Nomai are arriving at the warp receiver on Brittle Hollow slightly before departing from the White Hole Station.

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: I understand it’s exceedingly odd, but Clary and I have tested and retested the equipment, and the result is the same every time someone warps.
spirals.zh: 珀克：我明白这一现象极为奇怪，但是克莱瑞和我已经一次次地对设备进行过了测试，每一次的跃迁结果都是一样的。
spirals.zh_key: POKE: I understand it’s exceedingly odd, but Clary and I have tested and retested the equipment, and the result is the same every time someone warps.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: The interval is incredibly miniscule (roughly one hundred-thousandth of a second). Do you suppose our instruments can’t accurately measure time to such a small degree?
spirals.zh: 瑞米：其时间间隔异常微小（大约只有十万分之一秒）。你是否认为我们的仪器无法精确测量尺度如此微观的时间量？
spirals.zh_key: RAMIE: The interval is incredibly miniscule (roughly one hundred-thousandth of a second). Do you suppose our instruments can’t accurately measure time to such a small degree?

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: As I’ve already told Ramie, these measurements can’t be accurate. How can a Nomai arrive on Brittle Hollow before he or she ever stepped into the teleporter? The implications are absurd.
spirals.zh: 派伊：就像我对瑞米说过得那样，这些测量结果不可能精确。挪麦人怎么可能在踏上传送器之前，就已经抵达碎空星了呢？这其中的逻辑关系太荒谬了。
spirals.zh_key: PYE: As I’ve already told Ramie, these measurements can’t be accurate. How can a Nomai arrive on Brittle Hollow before he or she ever stepped into the teleporter? The implications are absurd.

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: I don’t disagree. It *would* mean I’ve inadvertently broken several fundamental theories regarding this universe. We would have to reconsider all of our beliefs about the nature of time.
spirals.zh: 珀克：我不同意。这可能意味着我不小心打破了这个宇宙的几个基本理论。我们应该重新考虑一下我们所有与时间本质有关的认知。
spirals.zh_key: POKE: I don’t disagree. It would mean I’ve inadvertently broken several fundamental theories regarding this universe. We would have to reconsider all of our beliefs about the nature of time.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: Yes, I hope so, too!
spirals.zh: 瑞米：没错，我也是这么认为的！
spirals.zh_key: RAMIE: Yes, I hope so, too!

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: Poke, as Pye is confident the reading is inaccurate, she’s kindly helping me attempt to recreate this phenomenon at the High Energy Lab. We’re designing an experiment to take more data.
spirals.zh: 瑞米：珀克，派伊坚信读数不准确，她好心要帮我在高能实验室试着再现这一现象。我们正在设计一次实验，来获取更多数据。
spirals.zh_key: RAMIE: Poke, as Pye is confident the reading is inaccurate, she’s kindly helping me attempt to recreate this phenomenon at the High Energy Lab. We’re designing an experiment to take more data.

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: An update: Poke, the High Energy Lab is in the canyon on Ember Twin’s equator. *Come here at once*. You need to see this.
spirals.zh: 派伊：更新：珀克，高能实验室位于余烬双星赤道的峡谷里。立刻过来。你得瞧瞧这个。
spirals.zh_key: PYE: An update: Poke, the High Energy Lab is in the canyon on Ember Twin’s equator. Come here at once. You need to see this.

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: Conoy, Daz and I were lifting Orbital Probe Cannon components into orbit for assembly, and one somehow sank down down *beneath* the current.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：科诺伊，戴兹和我正在把轨道探测炮组件送入轨道进行组装，结果有一个组件不知怎么沉到了洋流下方。

spirals.speaker: DAZ
spirals.text: Conoy, you should've seen it! We'd thought it was impossible for any canon components to sink even partially below the current, but ours sank straight to the core!
spirals.zh: 戴兹：科诺伊，你真该亲眼看看！我们原本以为任何大炮部件都不可能沉到洋流——哪怕只是一部分的下方。可我们的部件直接沉到了核心！

spirals.speaker: DAZ
spirals.text: Cassava convinced me not to try to recreate the phenomenon myself using other cannon parts, but we're very curious to know what happened! How could something pass through the current?
spirals.zh: 戴兹：卡萨瓦说服我不要用其他大炮部件亲自重现这个现象，但我们非常好奇到底发生了什么！怎么可能有什么东西穿过那道洋流？

spirals.text: Conoy: My gratitude for your interesting question! This is exciting: Spire constructed a model of Giant’s Deep here at the Brittle Hollow Southern Observatory, and it reveals how an object might sink below the current.
spirals.zh: 科诺伊：感谢你提出这个有趣的问题！这太令人激动了：斯拜尔在碎空星的南部天文台这里建造了一个深巨星模型，它揭示了物体可能如何沉到洋流下方。

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: Conoy, I'm unable to grasp the answer by looking through the projection pool. If I visit the observatory, would you kindly explain?
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：科诺伊，我通过投影池看不懂答案。如果我去天文台，你愿意为我解释一下吗？

spirals.text: Conoy: If you don't mind the trek beneath the surface to the south pole, I'd be delighted to see you! (The trailhead starts at Brittle Hollow’s equator)
spirals.zh: 科诺伊：如果你不介意走一趟地表下方，前往南极，我会很高兴见到你！（有两条路线起点，一条在碎空星的重力炮，另一条在量子知识之塔。）

spirals.speaker: CONOY
spirals.text: Cassava's Construction Yard has been using cyclones on Giant's Deep to lift Orbital Pobe Cannon parts into orbit, but one component was pushed past the current that usually prevents anything from sinking.
spirals.zh: 科诺伊：卡萨瓦的建造场一直在利用深巨星上的气旋，将轨道探测炮的零件送入轨道，但有一个部件被一股气旋推入了水下，穿过了通常能阻止任何东西下沉的洋流。

spirals.speaker: CONOY
spirals.text: Spire and I are crafting a model to determine why this happened.
spirals.zh: 科诺伊：斯拜尔和我正在制作一个模型，试图弄清为何会发生这种情况。

spirals.speaker: SPIRE
spirals.text: An update: It's now clear that there are two different types of cyclone.
spirals.zh: 斯拜尔：更新：现在可以确认，这里存在两种不同的气旋。

spirals.speaker: SPIRE
spirals.text: Most cyclones on Giant’s Deep rotate clockwise. These are the cyclones Cassava typically uses to send components into orbit.
spirals.zh: 斯拜尔：深巨星上的大多数气旋是顺时针旋转的，卡萨瓦通常用它们来将零件送入轨道。

spirals.speaker: SPIRE
spirals.text: There also exists a rarer type of cyclone that spins the opposite direction and pushes objects beneath the waters and below the current.
spirals.zh: 斯拜尔：此外还存在另一种较为罕见的气旋，会反方向旋转，把物体推下水面，穿越洋流沉入更深处。

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: My gratitude, Spire. Conoy is showing me your handiwork, and I'm intrigued by this secondary type of cyclone. But was it really necessary to build a model to tell me that?
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：谢过，斯拜尔。科诺伊正给我展示你的成果，我对第二种气旋很感兴趣。不过，为了告诉我这一点，真的有必要特地去制作一个模型吗？

spirals.speaker: SPIRE
spirals.text: The model will be useful as we continue monitoring Giant’s Deep.
spirals.zh: 斯拜尔：在我们持续监测深巨星的过程中，这个模型会很有用的。

spirals.speaker: SPIRE
spirals.text: Also I very much wanted to make a model.
spirals.zh: 斯拜尔：而且，我也非常想做一个模型出来。

spirals.speaker: CONOY
spirals.text: What have we learned thus far in our search for the Eye of the universe?
spirals.zh: 科诺伊：到目前为止，寻找宇宙之眼让我们了解到了哪些情况？
spirals.zh_key: CONOY: What have we learned thus far in our search for the Eye of the universe?

spirals.speaker: MALLOW
spirals.text: Based on our knowledge of the Quantum Moon, we believe the Eye is in orbit around this star system's sun. This would mean the Eye is located within a finite (albeit enormous) range.
spirals.zh: 玛罗：基于我们对量子卫星的了解，我们相信眼处在环绕该星系的太阳轨道上。也就是说眼位于有限（虽然范围异常之大）的距离之内。
spirals.zh_key: MALLOW: Based on our knowledge of the Quantum Moon, we believe the Eye is in orbit around this star system’s sun. This would mean the Eye is located within a finite (albeit enormous) range.

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: Those of us on the Vessel originally followed the Eye’s signal to this star system, but we were unable to warp to the Eye itself.
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：我们在飞船上的那些人最初跟着眼的信号来到了这个星系，但是我们无法跃迁到眼那里去。
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: Those of us on the Vessel originally followed the Eye’s signal to this star system, but we were unable to warp to the Eye itself.

spirals.speaker: PRIVET
spirals.text: the locator we built on the Attlerock and the new, more sensitive locator we built here were both unable to detect any trace of the Eye’s signal.
spirals.zh: 普利维特：我们在废岩星上建造的定位器，还有我们在这里新建造的更加灵敏的新型定位器，都无法检测到眼信号的任何踪迹。
spirals.zh_key: PRIVET: The locator we built on the Attlerock and the new, more sensitive locator we built here were both unable to detect any trace of the Eye’s signal.

spirals.speaker: AVENS
spirals.text: Hypothesis: The Eye has stopped emitting its signal.
spirals.zh: 埃文斯：假设：眼不再发射信号了。
spirals.zh_key: AVENS: Hypothesis: The Eye has stopped emitting its signal.

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: Suppose the Eye doesn't wish to be found.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：估计眼不想被别人找到。
spirals.zh_key: CASSAVA: Suppose the Eye doesn’t wish to be found.

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: Cassava, how can you suggest that? The Eye's signal called out to summon us to this star system!
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：卡萨瓦，你怎么能这么说？是眼的信号召唤我们来到了这个星系！
spirals.zh_key: PLUME: Cassava, how can you suggest that? The Eye’s signal called out to summon us to this star system!

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: I'm aware; I grew up hearing the Eye's story. Yet we're no closer to finding it than you were when you first arrived here.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：我知道；我是听着眼的故事长大的。可是和你第一次来到这里一样，我们压根就没法找到它。
spirals.zh_key: CASSAVA: I’m aware; I grew up hearing the Eye’s story. Yet we’re no closer to finding it than you were when you first arrived here.

spirals.speaker: CONOY
spirals.text: How should our methods change as we continue our search for the Eye of the universe?
spirals.zh: 科诺伊：假如要继续寻找宇宙之眼，我们应该改用怎样的搜索方法？
spirals.zh_key: CONOY: How should our methods change as we continue our search for the Eye of the universe?

spirals.speaker: PRIVET
spirals.text: As we couldn't find the Eye's signal using two different devices built for this exact purpose, we should discontinue this search method.
spirals.zh: 普利维特：两台专门用于寻找眼信号的设备都无法完成任务，我们不应该用这种方式继续找下去。
spirals.zh_key: PRIVET: As we couldn’t find the Eye’s signal using two different devices built for this exact purpose, we should discontinue this search method.

spirals.speaker: MALLOW
spirals.text: We know what the Eye looks like thanks to the Quantum Moon, so what if we try to find the Eye visually, instead? Let's send out a probe!
spirals.zh: 玛罗：多亏了量子卫星，我们知道了眼长什么样。那么我们就用肉眼去寻找眼如何？我们来发射一个探测器吧！
spirals.zh_key: MALLOW: We know what the Eye looks like thanks to the Quantum Moon, so what if we try to find the Eye visually, instead? Let’s send out a probe!

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: Mallow's idea is clever, but we have no idea where the Eye is in relation to here. The probability of launching a probe in the right direction would be absurdly small.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：玛罗的主意很不错，但是我们不知道眼与这里的相对位置。探测器发往正确方向的可能性微乎其微。
spirals.zh_key: CASSAVA: Mallow’s idea is clever, but we have no idea where the Eye is in relation to here. The probability of launching a probe in the correct direction would be absurdly small.

spirals.speaker: CONOY
spirals.text: I believe I have a solution to that problem! Have you spoken with Ramie and Pye about the technology they're developing?
spirals.zh: 科诺伊：我相信我有一个解决方法！你和瑞米以及派伊谈过他们正在开发的技术吗？
spirals.zh_key: CONOY: I believe I have a solution for that problem! Have you spoken with Ramie and Pye about the technology they’re developing?

spirals.speaker: AVENS
spirals.text: We'd need to build a probe-launching mechanism to cover those long distances quickly. A cannon in orbit around a celestial body would circumvent the need to escape gravity's pull.
spirals.zh: 埃文斯：我们需要建造一个发射装置，能够迅速地把探测器发射到如此远的距离去。在某个天体轨道上设置一门大炮应该可以摆脱重力的束缚。
spirals.zh_key: AVENS: We’d need to build a probe-launching mechanism to cover those long distances quickly. A cannon in orbit around a celestial body would circumvent the need to escape gravity’s pull.

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: Giant’s Deep would be a good choice. It's furthest from the sun, so it would provide the best angles for launch. And it's moonless (except for when the Quantum Moon is visiting).
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：深巨星是个不错的选择。它距离太阳最远，因此可以提供最佳的发射角度。而且它没有卫星（除非量子卫星来访）。
spirals.zh_key: CASSAVA: Giant’s Deep would be a good choice. It’s furthest from the sun, so it would provide the best angles for launch. And it’s moonless (except when the Quantum Moon is visiting).

spirals.speaker: AVENS
spirals.text: Yes, let's build the cannon in orbit around Giant’s Deep!
spirals.zh: 埃文斯：没错，我们就在深巨星的轨道上建造大炮吧！
spirals.zh_key: AVENS: Yes, let’s build the cannon in orbit around Giant’s Deep!

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: I'm at the shuttle! I'm ready to make my first pilgrimage to the Quantum Moon.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：我坐上了航天飞机！我准备好了。我即将要前往量子卫星，进行首次朝圣。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: I’m at the shuttle! I’m ready to make my first pilgrimage to the Quantum Moon.

spirals.speaker: BELLS
spirals.text: That's exciting! You're *almost* ready, but there's still one more rule you need to learn. Come see me at the Tower of Quantum Knowledge.
spirals.zh: 贝尔斯：真是叫人激动！你差不多准备好了。不过你还有一条法则需要学习。来量子知识之塔见我。
spirals.zh_key: BELLS: That’s exciting! You’re almost ready, but there’s still one more rule you need to learn. Come see me at the Tower of Quantum Knowledge.

spirals.speaker: BELLS
spirals.text: The tower is on the opposite side of Brittle Hollow. If you follow the path to the Crossroads, you can reach the tower from there.
spirals.zh: 贝尔斯：量子知识之塔在碎空星的另一头。如果你沿着西边的路走到十字路口，就能从那儿前往量子知识之塔。
spirals.zh_key: BELLS: The tower is on the opposite side of Brittle Hollow. If you follow the path west to the Crossroads, you can reach the tower from there.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: My gratitude for the directions, Bells. I'll see you soon!
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：感谢你为我指路，贝尔斯。我们回头见！
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: My gratitude for the directions, Bells. I’ll see you soon!

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: I am here! After watching it wander the skies for so long, I am about to stand (for the first time) on the Quantum Moon.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：我到了！一直以来，我都看着量子卫星在天空中流浪。如今我即将（第一次）踏上它的表面。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: I am here! After watching it wander the skies for so long, I am about to stand (for the first time) on the Quantum Moon.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: As expected, my shuttle has landed at the moon's south pole. I will make the remainder of my journey on foot.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：和预想中一样，我的航天飞机已经降落在了卫星的南极。剩下的路我就步行吧。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: As expected, my shuttle has landed at the moon’s south pole. I will make the remainder of my journey on foot.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: We don't know why the Quantum Moon always welcomes its visitors at the south pole, just that this is true.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：不知道为什么，凡是造访量子卫星的人，都会在南极降落。我只知道，这事从来都没有过例外。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: We don’t know why the Quantum Moon always welcomes its visitors at the south pole, just that this is true.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: As a child, I considered such unknowns sinister. Now though, I understand they bear no ill will. The universe is, and we are.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：我还小的时候，觉得这种让人无法理解的事情都很可疑。可现在，我明白了，其实谁也没有恶意。宇宙如此，我们也是一样。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: As a child, I considered such unknowns sinister. Now, though, I understand they bear no ill will. The universe is, and we are.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: I am ready.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：我准备好了。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: I am ready.

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: The *trees* are moving! The trees in this grove wander about freely (the entire plant, roots and all! This is *not* normal, even for this alien planet. And I never see them move! Is that even possible?!
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：树木在移动！这片树林里的树会到处乱跑（包括树根在内的整棵树）！就算这是一颗外星球，这种情况也绝对不正常。而我却从来没有见过它们移动的样子！这怎么可能？！

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: If anyone else witnesses this disturbing behaviour, I implore you, record your observations here. either these trees are aberrant, or my brain must be!
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：如果还有其他人目睹了这种令人不安的现象，我恳请你，把你的观察记录在这里。这些树和我的脑子之间肯定有一个出了问题！

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Plume is right; the trees *do* move! I confess I didn't notice until I read his notes.
spirals.zh: 萨奇：普鲁姆说得没错，那些树确实会动！老实说，在看到他的笔记之前，我并没有注意到这一点。

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Alarmingly, it isn't only the trees: There is other matter in this area (such as that unusual shard of rock) moving in this same eerie way.
spirals.zh: 萨奇：更令人担忧的是，不仅仅是树木：这片区域还有其他物质（比如那块不寻常的岩石碎片）也在以同样诡异的方式移动。

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: That rock is unusual for another reason, too, Thatch: It possesses color and texture I've never seen elsewhere on this planet
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：那块岩石还有一个不寻常的地方，萨奇：它的颜色和质地是我在这个星球上其他地方从未见过的！

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: Hypothesis: This rock shards presence is significant. We should study it! (Could it be what is causing other objects to also move about this area?)
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：假设：这块岩石碎片具有重大意义。我们应该对它展开研究！（附近的其它物体也在这一区域到处移动，会不会就是它引起的？）

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: Plume, Filix and I have determined this atypical shard of rock is the reason objects In this grove are behaving in a quantum manner.
spirals.zh: 萨奇：普鲁姆、费利克斯和我已经做出推断，这片树林的物体之所以会表现出量子特征，原因就是这种异常的岩石碎片。

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: Of note: A unique signal is coming from this shard! Curiously, our friend the wandering moon sounds the same.
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：注意：这块碎片在发出一种独特的信号！奇妙的是，我们的朋友，流浪卫星发出的信号听起来也如出一辙。

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: I've also heard the same signal this shard produces calling from Giant’s Deep, Timber Hearth, and the Hourglass Twins. Suppose there are other shards like this one!
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：我还听到深巨星、木炉星，和沙漏双星也传出了和这块碎片相同的信号。假设那里也有其它碎片，就像这块一样！

spirals.speaker: THATCH
spirals.text: The only other object we've observed displaying this quantum behaviour is the wandering moon. I imagine the moon’s behavior and the grove's are related.
spirals.zh: 萨奇：除它之外，唯一被我们观察到具有这种量子表现的物体只有流浪卫星，我想这片树林的行为和那颗卫星是相关的。

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: In her note from earlier, Filix mentions this strange type of rock isn't found elsewhere on Brittle Hollow. What if it isn't originally from this planet?
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：在费利克斯之前的笔记里，她提到过碎空星的其它地方并没有这种奇怪的岩石。如果它并不是来自于这颗行星呢？

spirals.speaker: PLUME
spirals.text: Hypothesis: This "quantum shard" is from the wandering (quantum) moon. Perhaps it is even a small piece of the moon itself.
spirals.zh: 普鲁姆：假设：这块“量子碎片”来自于流浪（量子）卫星。或许它就是卫星本身的一小块。

spirals.speaker: BELLS
spirals.text: Beneath your feet lies the Tower of Quantum Knowledge.
spirals.zh: 贝尔斯：在你的脚下，便是量子知识之塔。

spirals.speaker: BELLS
spirals.text: If you are preparing to make your first pilgrimage to the Quantum Moon, descend the steps to the entrance below. The knowledge held within will help you on your journey.
spirals.zh: 贝尔斯：如果你正准备前往量子卫星进行首次朝圣，请沿台阶下行，前往下方的入口。其中蕴藏的知识将在旅途中助你一臂之力。

spirals.speaker: BELLS
spirals.text: If you're here to make your first pilgrimage to the Quantum Moon, you are almost prepared to set out on this deeply significant journey. Before you do, pause and remember your history.
spirals.zh: 贝尔斯：如果你来到这里，是为了前往量子卫星进行首次朝圣，那么说明你已基本准备就绪，即将出发踏上这段意义深远的旅程。但在启程之前，请稍作停顿，回顾一下我们的历史。

spirals.speaker: BELLS
spirals.text: We make this journey not only for ourselves, but also to honour the members of our clan who came before us: Those who, after the crash that brought them to this star systems, became stranded on Brittle Hollow and on Ember Twin, with no communication between these two groups of survivors.
spirals.zh: 贝尔斯：此行的目的不仅仅是为了我们自己，也是为了缅怀族中的先辈：因坠机流落这个星系的两批幸存者，分别被困在碎空星和余烬双星上，彼此之间音讯全无。

spirals.speaker: BELLS
spirals.text: These Nomai looked upwards from two different planets and saw the same wandering moon visiting their skies. It was this moon (the Quantum Moon) that kept their curiosity alive during this long period of hardship.
spirals.zh: 贝尔斯：这些挪麦从两颗不同的星球上仰望宇宙，看着同样的流浪卫星造访天空。这段漫长的艰难岁月里，正是因为这颗卫星（量子卫星），大家内心的求知欲才没有被磨灭。

spirals.speaker: BELLS
spirals.text: After the two divided groups were able to reunite, it became our clan's united goal to find and visit the Quantum Moon. This took time, and many Nomai who dreamed of seeing the Quantum Moon died before we discovered how to make the journey.
spirals.zh: 贝尔斯：两批人终于得以重聚之后，寻找并拜访那颗量子卫星，就成了我们氏族共同的目标。这耗费了漫长的时光。许多梦想着能够见到量子卫星的挪麦，在我们发现展开旅程的办法之前就过世了。

spirals.speaker: BELLS
spirals.text: When you reach the Quantum Moon, recall these Nomai, and carry their curiosity onward with you.
spirals.zh: 贝尔斯：当你抵达量子卫星时，请铭记这些挪麦，带着所有人的求知欲一起走下去。

spirals.speaker: BELLS
spirals.text: Welcome, Solanum! Your arrival here means you've completed your preparations on Giant's Deep and are ready to depart for the Quantum Moon.
spirals.zh: 贝尔斯：欢迎，所莱内姆！既然你来到这里，想必是已经在深巨星上做好了准备，要启程去往量子卫星吧。

spirals.speaker: BELLS
spirals.text: On your pilgrimage, the Quantum Moon will carry you, just as it carried me and many in our clan before, to the moon's sixth and most secret location.
spirals.zh: 贝尔斯：一旦你踏上朝圣之旅，量子卫星就会载着你——正如过去载着我和族中许多先辈那样——带你前往卫星上第六个、也是最为秘密的地点。

spirals.speaker: BELLS
spirals.text: You'll be aided in your pilgrimage by the shrine our clan built on the Quantum Moon. But remember this final rule: To explore the sixth location, the shrine must be on the moon's north pole.
spirals.zh: 贝尔斯：我们氏族建在量子卫星上的祭坛会协助你完成朝圣。但一定要记好这条最后的法则：要想探索第六个位置，祭坛必须位于卫星的北极。

spirals.speaker: BELLS
spirals.text: Be curious on your journey!
spirals.zh: 贝尔斯：祝你在旅程中永葆好奇！

spirals.speaker: ROOT
spirals.text: Friends in the Timber Hearth mines, the last type of ore you sent us survives the longest in direct heat.
spirals.zh: 鲁特：木炉星矿井的各位朋友，你们寄给我们的矿石中，最后一种在直接受热时坚持的时间最长。
spirals.zh_key: ROOT: Friends in the Timber Hearth Mines, the last type of ore you sent us survives the longest in direct heat.

spirals.speaker: ROOT
spirals.text: Can you send us more of the same for additional testing? We're attempting to improve its durability, and our forge has already burned through everything you sent!
spirals.zh: 鲁特：能不能再寄来些这种矿石，好让我们再多做几次实验？我们想把耐久度再提高点，可你们寄来的东西都已经烧光了！
spirals.zh_key: ROOT: Can you send us more of the same for additional testing? We’re attempting to improve its durability, and our forge has already burned through everything you sent!

spirals.speaker: OENO
spirals.text: We’ll deliver more ore to Hollow’s Lantern immediately. You must be fired up about crafting the Ash Twin Project’s protective shell!
spirals.zh: 奥埃诺：我们将立即把更多矿石寄往空心灯。你们造起这个灰烬双星计划的保护外壳，还真是挺有干劲的嘛！
spirals.zh_key: OENO: We’ll deliver more ore to Hollow’s Lantern immediately. You must be fired up about crafting the Ash Twin Project’s protective shell!

spirals.speaker: ROOT
spirals.text: Yes, the idea of an encasement that's supernova-proof, however briefly, has kindled my curiosity!
spirals.zh: 鲁特：没错！隔绝超新星的保护壳，光是想到这个主意我就够兴奋的了！
spirals.zh_key: ROOT: Yes, the idea of an encasement that’s supernova-proof, however briefly, has kindled my curiosity!

spirals.speaker: ROOT
spirals.text: My gratitude! I imagine we'll also have an updated estimate soon of how much ore is needed to seal off the Ash Twin Project.
spirals.zh: 鲁特：太感谢了！那么，关于完成灰烬双星计划所需的具体矿石数量，想必近期就能向你们提供最新的估测结果。
spirals.zh_key: ROOT: My gratitude! I imagine we’ll also have an updated estimate soon of how much ore is needed to seal off the Ash Twin Project.

spirals.speaker: OENO
spirals.text: will it be more than we initially thought?
spirals.zh: 奥埃诺：会比我们最开始预计的还要多吗？
spirals.zh_key: OENO: Will it be more than we initially thought?

spirals.speaker: ROOT
spirals.text: it will be *significantly* more. The smallest cracking or opening in the protective shell would destroy everything.
spirals.zh: 鲁特：多大发了。保护外壳哪怕裂了一丁点，一切努力就都白费了。
spirals.zh_key: ROOT: It will be significantly more. The smallest crack or opening in the protective shell would destroy everything.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: Is this your first time on the Quantum Moon? It’s my first time here.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：你是第一次来到量子卫星吗？我是第一次来。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: Is this your first time on the Quantum Moon? It’s my first time here.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: If you’ve come looking for answers, I hope you find them.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：如果你是来寻找答案的，希望你能够如愿以偿。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: If you’ve come here looking for answers, I hope you find them.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: Suppose you could reach the Eye of the Universe: Would you try to enter it?
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：假如你能够到达宇宙之眼：你会想办法进去吗？
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: Suppose you could reach the Eye of the universe: Would you try to enter it?

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: What do you imagine the effects of a conscious observer might be?
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：你觉得有意识的观察者可能会造成怎样的影响？
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: What do you imagine the effects of a conscious observer might be?

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: We do not have much connection, you and I.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：你我之间没有太多的共同点。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: We do not have much connection, you and I.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: Still, this encounter feels special. I hope you won’t mind if I think of you as a friend.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：可是，这次相遇依然让我觉得非比寻常。我想把你当成朋友，希望你不要介意。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: Still, this encounter feels special. I hope you won’t mind if I think of you as a friend.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: I’ve never met with one of your kind before. It’s an honour to speak with you! I particularly admire your four eyes.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：我以前从来没有遇见过你们种族的人。能够和你交谈我十分荣幸！我特别喜欢你的四只眼睛。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: I’ve never met one of your kind before. It’s an honor to speak with you! I particularly admire your four eyes.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: There are many questions I would ask, if I could comprehend your language. You have my gratitude for understanding mine.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：要是我能够理解你们的语言就好了。我有许多问题想要问。你能够听懂我说的话，我实在是感激不尽。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: There are many questions I would ask, if I could comprehend your language. You have my gratitude for understanding mine.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: I imagine your purpose here is the same as mine; to learn about and to find the Eye of the Universe.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：我想你和我的目的一样：来这里了解并寻找宇宙之眼。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: I imagine your purpose here is the same as mine: to learn about and to find the Eye of the universe.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: I imagine you’ve noticed the Quantum Moon changes in appearance depending on which location it is currently orbiting (for instance, the moon looks quite different when orbiting Giant’s Deep than it does when orbiting the Hourglass Twins).
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：我想你已经注意到了，根据量子卫星当前环绕的轨道不同，它的外观也会发生变化（比如说，卫星在环绕深巨星的时候和环绕沙漏双星的时候，样子是完全不一样的）。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: I imagine you’ve noticed the Quantum Moon changes in appearance depending on which location it is currently orbiting (for instance, the moon looks quite different when orbiting Giant’s Deep than it does when orbiting the Hourglass Twins).

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: Because the Quantum Moon clearly changes in its different forms, the Eye (being this moon’s primary location) must be similarly malleable.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：因为量子卫星会在不同的形态之间产生变化，那么眼（该卫星的主要运动位置）一定也具备类似的可变性。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: Because the Quantum Moon clearly changes in its different forms, the Eye (being this moon’s primary location) must be similarly malleable.

spirals.text: From this, we can hypothesize that *the* *Eye* *represents extreme changeability*.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：由此，我们可以假设眼将会表现出异常多变的特性。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: From this, we can hypothesize that the Eye represents extreme changeability.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: Like many of my clan before me, I journeyed here to see the Quantum Moon’s reflection of the Eye. This is the closest any of us have come to seeing the Eye itself.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：我和之前的许多族人一样，来这里想要看看眼在量子卫星上的倒影。这是我们对眼进行的最近一次观察。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: Like many of my clan before me, I journeyed here to see the Quantum Moon’s reflection of the Eye. This is the closest any of us have come to seeing the Eye itself.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: You may think I’m strange, but I have a hypothesis that I may not be entirely alive. Perhaps my journey has reached its end.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：你可能会觉得我说这话很奇怪，不过我有一个假设，那就是我可能只是部分地活着。也许我的旅程已经走到了终点。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: You may think I’m strange, but I have a hypothesis that I may not be entirely alive. Perhaps my journey has reached its end.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: This is the Quantum Moon, where we both are standing.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：我们所站的地方叫做量子卫星。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: This is the Quantum Moon, where we both are standing.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: Despite also orbiting other celestial bodies, the Quantum Moon is the Eye of the universe’s moon.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：量子卫星是宇宙之眼的卫星，但它也会围绕其它天体运动。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: Despite also orbiting other celestial bodies, the Quantum Moon is the Eye of the universe’s moon.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: Have you encountered a quantum shard on another planet? The shards look the same as the Quantum Moon’s surface does now, while at the Eye.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：你有没有在其它行星上遇到过量子碎片？那些碎片的样子，就和现在量子卫星位于眼时其表面所展现出来的外观一样。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: Have you encountered a quantum shard on another planet? The shards look the same as the Quantum Moon’s surface does now, while at the Eye.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: From this, we can reasonably infer the Quantum Moon’s natural state is as we see it now, and that the Eye is its primary location.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：借此有理由推断，我们目前看到的就是量子卫星的自然状态。并且眼是它的主要运动位置。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: From this, we can reasonably infer the Quantum Moon’s natural state is as we see it now, and that the Eye is its primary location.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: Given that the Quantum Moon is the Eye’s moon, it’s likely that any characteristics the moon exhibits are also exhibited by the Eye itself. The Quantum Moon and its shards, for instance, are quantum; thus, the Eye is likely also quantum.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：鉴于量子卫星是眼的卫星，那么很可能眼也会具备卫星所展现出来的所有特性。比如说，量子卫星及其碎片是量子态的；因此，眼很可能也是量子态的。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: Given the Quantum Moon is the Eye’s moon, it’s likely that any characteristics the moon exhibits are also exhibited by the Eye itself. The Quantum Moon and its shards, for instance, are quantum; thus, the Eye is likely also quantum.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: Many in my clan believed the Eye called to us for a particular purpose.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：我的家族里有许多人相信眼呼叫我们是有特殊原因的。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: Many in my clan have believed the Eye called to us for a particular purpose.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: When I was a child, I used to believe the Eye was malevolent, to have lured my clan to this star system only to vanish from them so completely.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：小的时候，我以为眼不怀好意，想把我的家族引到这个星系来，好把我们彻底铲除。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: When I was a child, I used to believe the Eye was malevolent, to have lured my clan to this star system only to then vanish from them so completely.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: We are orbiting the Eye of the universe now, although we can not see it (only the Quantum Moon’s reflection of it). The Eye is older than the universe, and my clan believes it dwells in an extremely distant orbit around this star system.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：我们现在正在环绕宇宙之眼的轨道上。不过我们无法看见它（只能看见它在量子卫星上的倒影）。眼比宇宙本身还要古老。我的家族认为它处在一个十分遥远的轨道上环绕这个星系。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: We are orbiting the Eye of the universe now, although we cannot see it (only the Quantum Moon’s reflection of it). The Eye is older than the universe itself, and my clan believes it dwells in an extremely distant orbit around this star system.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: There is fundamental uncertainty throughout the universe. Normally, this uncertainty is only observable on a very small scale. As one approaches the Eye, however, that uncertainty grows enormously.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：整个宇宙遍布基础不确定性。一般来说，这种不确定性只能在非常微小的尺度上才能被观察到。但是，当有人接近眼的时候，它就会急剧放大。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: There is fundamental uncertainty throughout the universe. Normally, this uncertainty is only observable on a very small scale. As one approaches the Eye, however, that uncertainty grows enormously.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: The Quantum Moon probably exhibits macroscopic quantum behaviour because of its proximity to the Eye. Shards that broke off from the Quantum Moon have a similar effect, as I imagine you’ve seen elsewhere in this star system.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：量子卫星很可能是因为接近眼，所以才在宏观尺度上表现出了量子行为。从量子卫星上分离出来的碎片拥有类似的特性。我想你已经在这个星系的其它地方见到过了。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: The Quantum Moon probably exhibits macroscopic quantum behavior because of its proximity to the Eye. Shards that broke off from the Quantum Moon have a similar effect, as I imagine you’ve seen elsewhere in this star system.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: Conscious observance forces a quantum object to collapse to a single possibility. But what would happen if a conscious observer somehow entered the Eye itself?
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：对一个量子对象进行有意识地观察，将会使其坍缩为单一的可能态。但要是一个有意识的观察者进入眼，那么又会发生什么事情呢？
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: Conscious observation forces a quantum object to collapse to a single possibility. But what would happen if a conscious observer somehow entered the Eye itself?

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: Over time, this has become my clan’s greatest question.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：渐渐地，这个问题成为了我的家族最大的疑问。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: Over time, this has become my clan’s greatest question.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: I am Solanum, a Nomai. My clan arrived in this star system before my birth, and now we call it home.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：我叫所莱内姆，是一名挪麦人。在我出生之前，我的家族就来到了这个星系。如今，我们在这里安了家。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: I am Solanum, a Nomai. My clan arrived in this star system before my birth, and we now call it home.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: I am on my first pilgrimage to the Quantum Moon. All Nomai in my clan make this journey when we come of age.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：我正要前往量子卫星，进行首次朝圣。在我的家族里，所有的挪麦人一旦到了足够的年纪，都会踏上这样的旅程。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: I am on my first pilgrimage to the Quantum Moon. All Nomai in my clan make this journey when we come of age.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: Even though the Eye cannot be reached from here, the Quantum Moon remains special to us, as it carries us nearer to the Eye than any other place we know.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：虽然从这里无法抵达眼，但量子卫星对我们而言依然意义非凡。和别的地方相比，它可以带着我们来到最为靠近眼的地方。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: Even though the Eye cannot be reached from here, the Quantum Moon remains special to us, as it carries us nearer to the Eye than any other place we know.

spirals.speaker: SOLANUM
spirals.text: These are the two tenets of Nomai philosophy; to seek out and understand is our way of living.
spirals.zh: 所莱内姆：挪麦人信奉两大人生信条；寻找和理解是我们生命的意义。
spirals.zh_key: SOLANUM: These are the two tenets of Nomai philosophy; to seek out and to understand is our way of living.

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: This is it: We've finished building the final Orbital Probe Cannon module and are ready to send it into orbit around Giant’s Deep for assembly!
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：行了：我们已经完成了轨道探测炮最终模块的建造，并准备把它送入深巨星的轨道进行组装！
spirals.zh_key: CASSAVA: This is it: We’ve finished building the final Orbital Probe Cannon module and are ready to send it into orbit around Giant’s Deep for assembly!

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: Our next step will be to send Privet up to the Orbital Probe Cannon to install the probe tracking system.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：下一步，我们要把普利维特送上轨道探测炮来安装探测跟踪系统。
