spirals.zh_key: CASSAVA: Our next step will be to send Privet up to the Orbital Probe Cannon to install the probe tracking system.

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: To all my friends here at the Construction Yard, my gratitude for your tireless work. I had given up hope, but I truly believe this cannon may actually succeed where many other attempts have not.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：所有建造厂的朋友们，我感激你们孜孜不倦的劳作。我曾经失去了希望，但我真诚地相信这门大炮可以实现许多前人无法实现的成就。
spirals.zh_key: CASSAVA: To all my friends here at the Construction Yard, my gratitude for your tireless work. I had given up hope, but I truly believe this cannon may actually succeed where many other attempts have not.

spirals.speaker: DAZ
spirals.text: Are you going gelatinous on us, love? I'm delighted by your words, but they're atypical for you!
spirals.zh: 戴兹：你在跟我们套近乎吗，亲爱的？你的话让我很高兴，但那也太不像你了！
spirals.zh_key: DAZ: Are you going gelatinous on us, love? I’m delighted by your words, but they’re atypical for you!

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: If I'm ever half as gooey as Mallow and Avens behave together, darling, you may launch *me* from the Orbital Probe Cannon.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：要是我有玛罗和埃文斯加起来一半软弱，戴兹，你就把我装在轨道探测炮里发射出去。
spirals.zh_key: CASSAVA: If I’m ever half as gooey as Mallow and Avens behave together, Daz, you may launch me from the Orbital Probe Cannon.

spirals.speaker: DAZ
spirals.text: If I know my brother, Avens (and his spouse) will want to launch the probe with as much power as possible. I'm worried the cannon would break under the strain.
spirals.zh: 戴兹：我了解我的兄弟，埃文斯（和他的配偶）会动用一切可能的动力来发射探测器。我担心大炮会承受不住而坏掉。
spirals.zh_key: DAZ: If I know my brother, Avens (and his spouse) will want to launch the probe with as much power as possible. I’m worried the cannon would break under the strain.

spirals.speaker: DAZ
spirals.text: I propose we give Avens and Mallow a slightly lower maximum power setting than the absolute maximum possible to create room for their enthusiasm.
spirals.zh: 戴兹：我建议我们给埃文斯和玛罗分配动力的时候，在最大绝对值的基础上稍微做一点削减，为他们的工作热忱创造一些空间。
spirals.zh_key: DAZ: I propose we give Avens and Mallow a slightly lower maximum power setting than the absolute maximum possible to create room for their enthusiasm.

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: I have bad news, Avens. Yarrow says there was a problem with the proposed power source, so the Orbital Probe Cannon won't be asked to fire.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：我有一些坏消息，埃文斯。亚罗说推荐的动力源出了问题，无法请求轨道探测炮进行发射。
spirals.zh_key: CASSAVA: I have bad news, Avens. Yarrow says there was a problem with the proposed power source, so the Orbital Probe Cannon won’t be asked to fire.

spirals.speaker: AVENS
spirals.text: I hope you're pulling my locomotive limb here, Cassava.
spirals.zh: 埃文斯：但愿你是在跟我开玩笑，卡萨瓦。
spirals.zh_key: AVENS: I hope you’re pulling my locomotive limb here, Cassava.

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: I wish I were, my friend, but no. They aren't certain they can fix the problem, so the Orbital Probe Cannon is on an indefinite hiatus.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：要是真的是这样就好了。他们无法确定问题出在哪儿，也修不好，所以轨道探测炮只能无限期搁置。
spirals.zh_key: CASSAVA: I wish I were, my friend, but no. They aren’t certain they can fix the problem, so the Orbital Probe Cannon is on indefinite hiatus.

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: Tell Privet and Mallow they should return from the cannon. Me and Daz will remain at the Construction Yard, for now.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：告诉普利维特和玛罗，让他们从大炮那儿回来。我的配偶和我暂时要留在建造厂。
spirals.zh_key: CASSAVA: Tell Privet and Mallow they should return from the cannon. My spouse and I will remain at the Construction Yard, for now.

spirals.speaker: AVENS
spirals.text: An update: Mallow and I will join you and Daz. Privet left to visit her brother. She fears Idaea may feel responsible.
spirals.zh: 埃文斯：更新：玛罗和我会来找你和戴兹。普利维特去找她的兄弟了。她担心伊代亚会有自责情绪。
spirals.zh_key: AVENS: An update: Mallow and I will join you and Daz. Privet left to visit her brother. She fears Idaea may feel responsible.

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: Conoy, Daz and I were lifting Orbital Probe Cannon components into orbit for assembly, and one somehow sank down down *beneath* the current.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：科诺伊，戴兹和我正在把轨道探测炮组件送入轨道进行组装，结果有一个组件不知怎么沉到了洋流下方。

spirals.speaker: DAZ
spirals.text: Conoy, you should've seen it! We'd thought it was impossible for any canon components to sink even partially below the current, but ours sank straight to the core!
spirals.zh: 戴兹：科诺伊，你真该亲眼看看！我们原本以为任何大炮部件都不可能沉到洋流——哪怕只是一部分的下方。可我们的部件直接沉到了核心！

spirals.speaker: DAZ
spirals.text: Cassava convinced me not to try to recreate the phenomenon myself using other cannon parts, but we're very curious to know what happened! How could something pass through the current?
spirals.zh: 戴兹：卡萨瓦说服我不要用其他大炮部件亲自重现这个现象，但我们非常好奇到底发生了什么！怎么可能有什么东西穿过那道洋流？

spirals.text: Conoy: My gratitude for your interesting question! This is exciting: Spire constructed a model of Giant’s Deep here at the Brittle Hollow Southern Observatory, and it reveals how an object might sink below the current.
spirals.zh: 科诺伊：感谢你提出这个有趣的问题！这太令人激动了：斯拜尔在碎空星的南部天文台这里建造了一个深巨星模型，它揭示了物体可能如何沉到洋流下方。

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: Conoy, I'm unable to grasp the answer by looking through the projection pool. If I visit the observatory, would you kindly explain?
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：科诺伊，我通过投影池看不懂答案。如果我去天文台，你愿意为我解释一下吗？

spirals.text: Conoy: If you don't mind the trek beneath the surface to the south pole, I'd be delighted to see you! (The trailhead starts at Brittle Hollow’s equator)
spirals.zh: 科诺伊：如果你不介意走一趟地表下方，前往南极，我会很高兴见到你！（有两条路线起点，一条在碎空星的重力炮，另一条在量子知识之塔。）

spirals.speaker: LAMI
spirals.text: They're going to test the memory statues tonight! Phlox says it could be dangerous, so we can't come.
spirals.zh: 拉米：他们今天晚上要去测试回忆雕像！弗拉克斯说现场可能会很危险，所以我们不能去。
spirals.zh_key: LAMI: They’re going to test the memory statues tonight! Phlox says it could be dangerous, so we can’t come.

spirals.speaker: LAMI
spirals.text: *But,* what if we didn't use the door and snuck in the *other* way? Does anyone want to?
spirals.zh: 拉米：不过，假如我们不走大门，从别的地方摸进去呢？有谁想去吗？
spirals.zh_key: LAMI: But, what if we didn’t use the door and snuck in the other way? Does anyone want to?

spirals.speaker: TAGET
spirals.text: Phlox *specifically* told us not to do that.
spirals.zh: 塔格特：弗拉克斯特别跟我们强调过别那么做。
spirals.zh_key: TAGET: Phlox specifically told us not to do that.

spirals.speaker: LAEVI
spirals.text: I really want to see the test too, Lami, but that's a huge risk to take. We probably shouldn't. Maybe Phlox'll let us see a later test.
spirals.zh: 莱阿维：我也非常想去看看试验的情况，拉米，但是这样做太冒险了。也许我们不该去。也许弗拉克斯会让我们去参观一次后期试验。
spirals.zh_key: LAEVI: I really want to see the test, too, Lami, but that’s a huge risk to take. We probably shouldn’t. Maybe Phlox’ll let us see a later test.

spirals.speaker: PHLOX
spirals.text: Yarrow, would you kindly step back so Daz is closest to the statue? When pairing, the statue will choose whoever is in closest proximity.
spirals.zh: 弗拉克斯：亚罗，能不能请你退后一点？这样戴兹才能距离雕像最近。到时候，雕像会选择最近的人来进行匹配。
spirals.zh_key: PHLOX: Yarrow, would you kindly step back so Daz is closest to the statue? When pairing, the statue will choose whoever is in closest proximity.

spirals.speaker: PHLOX
spirals.text: …See how its eyes have opened? That tells us the statue has paired with Daz. Now, no matter where he is in this star system, Daz's statue will record his memories and send them to the Ash Twin Project.
spirals.zh: 弗拉克斯：……看见它睁开眼睛的样子了吗？这说明雕像已经和戴兹进行了匹配。现在，不管戴兹处在这个星系的什么地方，雕像都会把他的回忆记录下来，并发往灰烬双星计划。
spirals.zh_key: PHLOX: ...See how its eyes have opened? That tells us the statue has paired with Daz. Now, no matter where he is in this star system, Daz’s statue will record his memories and send them to the Ash Twin Project.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: This is extraordinary sculpting work, Phlox!
spirals.zh: 亚罗：弗拉克斯，你的这座雕像真是非凡！
spirals.zh_key: YARROW: This is extraordinary sculpting work, Phlox!

spirals.speaker: DAZ
spirals.text: He has outdone himself again, hasn't he? And now that we have our first successful pairing, we can test my memory storage prototype.
spirals.zh: 戴兹：他再次突破了自己，对不对？既然第一例匹配已经成功，那么我们现在可以测试一下我的回忆存储原型了。
spirals.zh_key: DAZ: He has outdone himself again, hasn’t he? And now that we have our first successful pairing, we can test my memory storage prototype.

spirals.speaker: DAZ
spirals.text: Each statue will send a single Nomai’s memories to his or her own storage unit within the Ash Twin.
spirals.zh: 戴兹：每座雕像都会把一个挪麦人的回忆发送到他或者她自己位于灰烬双星的存储单元里。
spirals.zh_key: DAZ: Each statue will send a single Nomai’s memories to his or her own storage unit within Ash Twin.

spirals.speaker: PHLOX
spirals.text: Each storage unit will be equipped with a mask, the statue’s counterpart, which will be able to send those stored memories back to the corresponding Nomai.
spirals.zh: 弗拉克斯：每个存储单元都配有和雕像成对的面具，可以将那些存储起来的回忆重新发送给相应的挪麦人。
spirals.zh_key: PHLOX: Each storage unit will be equipped with a mask, the statue’s counterpart, which will be able to send those stored memories back to the corresponding Nomai.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: I've installed the masks inside the Ash Twin Project, Phlox. They look beautiful (although I do feel as though I'm being observed!).
spirals.zh: 瑞米：弗拉克斯，我已经安装好了灰烬双星计划内部的面具。它们看上去很漂亮（不过我觉得它们好像在观察我！）。
spirals.zh_key: RAMIE: I’ve installed the masks inside the Ash Twin Project, Phlox. They look beautiful (although I do feel as though I’m being observed!).

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: It's comforting to know the statues will not pair until the project succeeds. Otherwise, I imagine the experience would be hard to endure!
spirals.zh: 瑞米：还好雕像在计划成功之前不会进行匹配。不然的话，那一定是叫人难以忍受的体验！
spirals.zh_key: RAMIE: It’s comforting to know the statues will not pair until the project succeeds. Otherwise, I imagine the experience would be hard to endure!

spirals.speaker: PHLOX
spirals.text: Ideally, they'll only need to activate once the project succeeds; as a safety measure, however, the states will also activate in the event of equipment failure.
spirals.zh: 弗拉克斯：理想的情况下，我们只需要在计划成功时启动它们；不过作为安全措施，这些雕像也会在设备出现故障的时候被启动。
spirals.zh_key: PHLOX: Ideally, they’ll only need to activate once the project succeeds; as a safety measure, however, the statues will also activate in the event of equipment failure.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: They will? Why is that?
spirals.zh: 瑞米：真的吗？那是为什么？
spirals.zh_key: RAMIE: They will? Why is that?

spirals.speaker: PHLOX
spirals.text: If anything goes wrong with the Ash Twin Project, the statues (and their masks) will make us aware of the situation and enable us to fix it. Otherwise, it would be possible for us to remain permanently unaware of the problem.
spirals.zh: 弗拉克斯：如果灰烬双星计划出现问题，雕像（还有它们的面具）可以把情况通知给我们，让我们进行修复。不然的话，我们就可能永远也不知道出了什么问题。
spirals.zh_key: PHLOX: If anything goes wrong with the Ash Twin Project, the statues (and their masks) will make us aware of the situation and enable us to fix it. Otherwise, it would be possible for us to remain permanently unaware of the problem.

spirals.speaker: RAMIE
spirals.text: I hadn't thought of that! What a profoundly horrific thought that would be.
spirals.zh: 瑞米：这我倒是没想过！那将会多么可怕的情况啊。
spirals.zh_key: RAMIE: I hadn’t thought of that! What a profoundly horrific fate that would be.

spirals.text: Be welcomed in this place. This tower shares with all who ask the knowledge needed to make his or her first quantum journey.
spirals.zh: 欢迎来到这个地方。这座高塔有求必应，会和任何人分享他或者她踏上第一次量子之旅需要了解的知识。
spirals.zh_key: Be welcomed in this place. This tower shares with all who ask the knowledge needed to make his or her first quantum journey.

spirals.text: Enter this place without friends, however; these are lessons to learn for yourself.
spirals.zh: 但是，只能孤身进入；其中的道理你要自己去领会。
spirals.zh_key: Enter this place without friends, however; these are lessons to learn for yourself.

spirals.text: Seek the wondering arch.
spirals.zh: 寻找流浪拱门。
spirals.zh_key: Seek the wandering arch.

spirals.text: Observing a quantum object; observing an image of a quantum object. These are the same.
spirals.zh: 观察一个量子对象；观察一个量子对象的图形。它们是一样的事情。
spirals.zh_key: Observing a quantum object; observing an image of a quantum object. These are the same.

spirals.text: The arch and the crystal do not naturally meet.
spirals.zh: 拱门和水晶无法自然交汇。
spirals.zh_key: The arch and the crystal do not naturally meet.

spirals.text: This is the last one (but we made it harder)
spirals.zh: 这是最后一个（但是我们增加了难度）。
spirals.zh_key: This is the last one (but we made it harder).

spirals.text: We offer our congratulations! You've learned the rule of quantum imaging. Take this knowledge with you on the remainder of your quantum pilgrimage.
spirals.zh: 在此献上我们的祝贺！你已学会了量子成像法则。就带着这个知识伴你度过余下的量子朝圣之旅。
spirals.zh_key: We offer our congratulations! You’ve learned the rule of quantum imaging. Take this knowledge with you on the remainder of your quantum pilgrimage.

spirals.text: Remember, the other quantum shards have other lessons to teach.
spirals.zh: 记住，其它的内容可以从别的量子碎片那里学习。
spirals.zh_key: Remember, the other quantum shards have other lessons to teach.

spirals.text: Our curiosity goes with you on your journey. You walk in the footsteps of those who came before you, and your path guides those who will follow later.
spirals.zh: 我们对你的旅程充满好奇心。你将跟随前人的脚步，带领后人走向正确的道路。
spirals.zh_key: Our curiosity goes with you on your journey. You walk in the footsteps of those who came before you, and your path guides those who will follow later.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: I have exciting news, Privet: the Ash Twin Project is almost prepared to receive the probe data from the Orbital Probe Cannon.
spirals.zh: 亚罗：我有一些激动人心的消息，普利维特：灰烬双星计划即将准备就绪，可以接受轨道探测炮传来的探测器数据了。
spirals.zh_key: YARROW: I have exciting news, Privet: The Ash Twin Project is almost prepared to receive the probe data from the Orbital Probe Cannon.

spirals.speaker: YARROW
spirals.text: Ramie is adding some finishing touches here, but she'll be finished soon. Are you and the Orbital Probe Cannon well?
spirals.zh: 亚罗：瑞米正在做最后的收尾工作，不过她马上就能完工。你和轨道探测炮都没问题吧？
spirals.zh_key: YARROW: Ramie is adding some finishing touches here, but she’ll be finished soon. Are you and the Orbital Probe Cannon well?

spirals.speaker: PRIVET
spirals.text: We are! The Probe Tracking Module is ready to record each launch's flight trajectory and will automatically transmit all relevant data to you.
spirals.zh: 普利维特：没问题！探测器跟踪模块已经就绪，能够记录每次发射的飞行轨迹，并且会把相关的数据自动传给你。
spirals.zh_key: PRIVET: We are! The statue here in the Probe Tracking Module is ready to record each launch’s flight trajectory and will automatically transmit all relevant data to you.

spirals.speaker: PRIVET
spirals.text: On the other appendage, I'm now worried about this cannon's structural integrity and its crew's moral integrity.
spirals.zh: 普利维特：而另一方面，我现在担心的是这门大炮的结构还有乘员的精神是不是健全。
spirals.zh_key: PRIVET: On the other appendage, I’m now worried about this cannon’s structural integrity and its crew’s moral integrity.

spirals.speaker: PRIVET
spirals.text: Once the probe determines the location of the Eye of the universe, I'll send an alert directly to you and Ramie.
spirals.zh: 普利维特：一旦探测器发现宇宙之眼的位置，我就会直接通知你和瑞米。
spirals.zh_key: PRIVET: Once the probe determines the location of the Eye of the universe, I’ll send an alert directly to you and Ramie.

spirals.speaker: MALLOW
spirals.text: Imagine Privet: The Probe Tracking Module will be held first to know the coordinates of the Eye of the universe! You'll be the first to see them!
spirals.zh: 玛罗：想想看，普利维特：探测器跟踪模块将会头一个获取宇宙之眼的坐标！而你则是第一个得知这一坐标的人！
spirals.zh_key: MALLOW: Imagine, Privet: the Probe Tracking Module will be the first to know the coordinates of the Eye of the universe! You’ll be the first to see them!

spirals.speaker: PRIVET
spirals.text: I am honoured and terrified!
spirals.zh: 普利维特：我深感荣幸，惶恐之至！
spirals.zh_key: PRIVET: I am honored and terrified!

spirals.speaker: PRIVET
spirals.text: You won't ask them Orbital Probe Cannon to use so much power that it breaks, will you?
spirals.zh: 普利维特：你不会让轨道探测炮动用太多动力，把它给弄坏吧？
spirals.zh_key: PRIVET: You won’t ask the Orbital Probe Cannon to use so much power that it breaks, will you?

spirals.speaker: MALLOW
spirals.text: Fret not, my nervous friend! We only need to fire the probe cannon once, anyway, so who minds if it compromises the Orbital Probe Cannon’s structural integrity slightly?
spirals.zh: 玛罗：别紧张，我爱操心的朋友！反正我们只会发射一次探测器，就算是轨道探测炮的结构有轻微的损坏，又会有谁在乎呢？
spirals.zh_key: MALLOW: Fret not, my nervous friend! We only need to fire the probe once, anyway, so who minds if it compromises the Orbital Probe Cannon’s structural integrity slightly?

spirals.speaker: PRIVET
spirals.text: I would mind, Mallow! I would mind, because we won't be capable of receiving our probe’s data if the Probe Tracking Module is destroyed!
spirals.zh: 普利维特：我在乎，玛罗！我在乎，因为要是探测器跟踪模块损毁，那我们就没法接受探测器传来的数据了！
spirals.zh_key: PRIVET: I would mind, Mallow! I would mind, because we won’t be capable of receiving our probe’s data if the Probe Tracking Module is destroyed!

spirals.speaker: AVENS
spirals.text: Mallow, my better 50 percent! Cassava is sending the last of the cannon components. Soon (relatively speaking), we'll know the Eye’s precise location!
spirals.zh: 埃文斯：玛罗，我的另一半！卡萨瓦把最后一批大炮部件给送了过来。很快（相对而言），我们就会知道眼的确切位置了！
spirals.zh_key: AVENS: Mallow, my better 50 percent! Cassava is sending the last of the cannon components. Soon (relatively speaking), we’ll know the Eye’s precise location!

spirals.speaker: MALLOW
spirals.text: The thought of concluding our elders' curious and challenging search increases my heart's temperature, love!
spirals.zh: 玛罗：一想到能够解开前人的谜题，结束这次艰难的搜索，我就心跳不止，我的爱人！
spirals.zh_key: MALLOW: The thought of concluding our elders’ curious and challenging search increases my heart’s temperature, my love!

spirals.speaker: AVENS
spirals.text: Cassava tells me he and the construction yard crew have determined a power setting we are not, under any circumstances, to go above.
spirals.zh: 埃文斯：卡萨瓦告诉我，他和建造厂的人员已经规定了动力设置的上限。不管什么情况，我们都不能超出这个上限。
spirals.zh_key: AVENS: Cassava tells me he and the Construction Yard crew have determined a power setting we are not, under any circumstances, to go above.

spirals.speaker: MALLOW
spirals.text: I see! Am I right to think that, consequently, we'll be ignoring that setting?
spirals.zh: 玛罗：我懂了！我是不是由此可以推断，我们要无视这样的设置？
spirals.zh_key: MALLOW: I see! And am I right to think that, consequently, we’ll be ignoring that setting?

spirals.speaker: AVENS
spirals.text: I can posit with nearly 100 percent certainty our friends have accounted for our natures, so I suggest we do!
spirals.zh: 埃文斯：我可以百分之一百地假定，我们的朋友已经把我们的本性给考虑了进去，因此我认为我们应该无视这一设置！
spirals.zh_key: AVENS: I can posit with nearly 100 percent certainty our friends have accounted for our natures, so I suggest we do!

spirals.speaker: AVENS
spirals.text: Giving the Orbital Probe Cannon all the power it can structurally withstand creates the greatest chance of finding the Eye of the universe.
spirals.zh: 埃文斯：把动力提高到轨道探测炮结构所能承受的极限，就可以最大限度地增加发现宇宙之眼的机会。
spirals.zh_key: AVENS: Giving the Orbital Probe Cannon all the power it can structurally withstand creates the greatest chance of finding the Eye of the universe.

spirals.speaker: MALLOW
spirals.text: Yes, the probe must travel as fast as it can, as far as it can. I'll make some adjustments!
spirals.zh: 玛罗：是的，探测器一定要飞得尽可能快，尽可能远才行。我这就来进行调整！
spirals.zh_key: MALLOW: Yes, the probe must travel as fast as it can, as far as it can. I’ll make some adjustments!

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: I have bad news, Avens. Yarrow says there was a problem with the proposed power source, so the Orbital Probe Cannon won't be asked to fire.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：我有一些坏消息，埃文斯。亚罗说推荐的动力源出了问题，无法请求轨道探测炮进行发射。
spirals.zh_key: CASSAVA: I have bad news, Avens. Yarrow says there was a problem with the proposed power source, so the Orbital Probe Cannon won’t be asked to fire.

spirals.speaker: AVENS
spirals.text: I hope you're pulling my locomotive limb here, Cassava.
spirals.zh: 埃文斯：但愿你是在跟我开玩笑，卡萨瓦。
spirals.zh_key: AVENS: I hope you’re pulling my locomotive limb here, Cassava.

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: I wish I were, my friend, but no. They aren't certain they can fix the problem, so the Orbital Probe Cannon is on an indefinite hiatus.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：要是真的是这样就好了。他们无法确定问题出在哪儿，也修不好，所以轨道探测炮只能无限期搁置。
spirals.zh_key: CASSAVA: I wish I were, my friend, but no. They aren’t certain they can fix the problem, so the Orbital Probe Cannon is on indefinite hiatus.

spirals.speaker: CASSAVA
spirals.text: Tell Privet and Mallow they should return from the cannon. Me and Daz will remain at the Construction Yard, for now.
spirals.zh: 卡萨瓦：告诉普利维特和玛罗，让他们从大炮那儿回来。我的配偶和我暂时要留在建造厂。
spirals.zh_key: CASSAVA: Tell Privet and Mallow they should return from the cannon. My spouse and I will remain at the Construction Yard, for now.

spirals.speaker: AVENS
spirals.text: An update: Mallow and I will join you and Daz. Privet left to visit her brother. She fears Idaea may feel responsible.
spirals.zh: 埃文斯：更新：玛罗和我会来找你和戴兹。普利维特去找她的兄弟了。她担心伊代亚会有自责情绪。
spirals.zh_key: AVENS: An update: Mallow and I will join you and Daz. Privet left to visit her brother. She fears Idaea may feel responsible.

spirals.speaker: MALLOW
spirals.text: Imagine Privet: The Probe Tracking Module will be held first to know the coordinates of the Eye of the universe! You'll be the first to see them!
spirals.zh: 玛罗：想想看，普利维特：探测器跟踪模块将会头一个获取宇宙之眼的坐标！而你则是第一个得知这一坐标的人！
spirals.zh_key: MALLOW: Imagine, Privet: the Probe Tracking Module will be the first to know the coordinates of the Eye of the universe! You’ll be the first to see them!

spirals.speaker: PRIVET
spirals.text: I am honoured and terrified!
spirals.zh: 普利维特：我深感荣幸，惶恐之至！
spirals.zh_key: PRIVET: I am honored and terrified!

spirals.speaker: PRIVET
spirals.text: You won't ask them Orbital Probe Cannon to use so much power that it breaks, will you?
spirals.zh: 普利维特：你不会让轨道探测炮动用太多动力，把它给弄坏吧？
spirals.zh_key: PRIVET: You won’t ask the Orbital Probe Cannon to use so much power that it breaks, will you?

spirals.speaker: MALLOW
spirals.text: Fret not, my nervous friend! We only need to fire the probe cannon once, anyway, so who minds if it compromises the Orbital Probe Cannon’s structural integrity slightly?
spirals.zh: 玛罗：别紧张，我爱操心的朋友！反正我们只会发射一次探测器，就算是轨道探测炮的结构有轻微的损坏，又会有谁在乎呢？
spirals.zh_key: MALLOW: Fret not, my nervous friend! We only need to fire the probe once, anyway, so who minds if it compromises the Orbital Probe Cannon’s structural integrity slightly?

spirals.speaker: PRIVET
spirals.text: I would mind, Mallow! I would mind, because we won't be capable of receiving our probe’s data if the Probe Tracking Module is destroyed!
spirals.zh: 普利维特：我在乎，玛罗！我在乎，因为要是探测器跟踪模块损毁，那我们就没法接受探测器传来的数据了！
spirals.zh_key: PRIVET: I would mind, Mallow! I would mind, because we won’t be capable of receiving our probe’s data if the Probe Tracking Module is destroyed!

spirals.speaker: AVENS
spirals.text: Mallow, my better 50 percent! Cassava is sending the last of the cannon components. Soon (relatively speaking), we'll know the Eye’s precise location!
spirals.zh: 埃文斯：玛罗，我的另一半！卡萨瓦把最后一批大炮部件给送了过来。很快（相对而言），我们就会知道眼的确切位置了！
spirals.zh_key: AVENS: Mallow, my better 50 percent! Cassava is sending the last of the cannon components. Soon (relatively speaking), we’ll know the Eye’s precise location!

spirals.speaker: MALLOW
spirals.text: The thought of concluding our elders' curious and challenging search increases my heart's temperature, love!
spirals.zh: 玛罗：一想到能够解开前人的谜题，结束这次艰难的搜索，我就心跳不止，我的爱人！
spirals.zh_key: MALLOW: The thought of concluding our elders’ curious and challenging search increases my heart’s temperature, my love!

spirals.speaker: AVENS
spirals.text: Cassava tells me he and the Construction Yard crew have determined a power setting we are not, under any circumstances, to go above.
spirals.zh: 埃文斯：卡萨瓦告诉我，他和建造厂的人员已经规定了动力设置的上限。不管什么情况，我们都不能超出这个上限。
spirals.zh_key: AVENS: Cassava tells me he and the Construction Yard crew have determined a power setting we are not, under any circumstances, to go above.

spirals.speaker: MALLOW
spirals.text: I see! Am I right to think that, consequently, we'll be ignoring that setting?
spirals.zh: 玛罗：我懂了！我是不是由此可以推断，我们要无视这样的设置？
spirals.zh_key: MALLOW: I see! And am I right to think that, consequently, we’ll be ignoring that setting?

spirals.speaker: AVENS
spirals.text: I can posit with nearly 100 percent certainty our friends have accounted for our natures, so I suggest we do!
spirals.zh: 埃文斯：我可以百分之一百地假定，我们的朋友已经把我们的本性给考虑了进去，因此我认为我们应该无视这一设置！
spirals.zh_key: AVENS: I can posit with nearly 100 percent certainty our friends have accounted for our natures, so I suggest we do!

spirals.speaker: AVENS
spirals.text: Giving the Orbital Probe Cannon all the power it can structurally withstand creates the greatest chance of finding the Eye of the universe.
spirals.zh: 埃文斯：把动力提高到轨道探测炮结构所能承受的极限，就可以最大限度地增加发现宇宙之眼的机会。
spirals.zh_key: AVENS: Giving the Orbital Probe Cannon all the power it can structurally withstand creates the greatest chance of finding the Eye of the universe.

spirals.speaker: MALLOW
spirals.text: Yes, the probe must travel as fast as the can, as far as it can. I'll make some adjustments!
spirals.zh: 玛罗：是的，探测器一定要飞得尽可能快，尽可能远才行。我这就来进行调整！
spirals.zh_key: MALLOW: Yes, the probe must travel as fast as it can, as far as it can. I’ll make some adjustments!

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: This is troublesome. It seems the comet wishes to submerge our shuttle in ice. If we stay on the surface too long, the shuttle may freeze entirely.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：这有些麻烦：这颗彗星似乎想把我们的航天飞机埋进冰里。如果我们在表面停留太久，航天飞机可能会完全冻住。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Even if it did, couldn’t someone call it back home to the gravity cannon on Ember Twin?
spirals.zh: 珀克：就算真的冻住了，不也可以让某个人从余烬双星的重力炮那里把它召回去吗？

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Yes, but the exploration of the comet would be more difficult if we were without the shuttle until someone recalled it. Perhaps we shouldn’t have landed on the dark side of the comet…
spirals.zh: 派伊：可以，但在有人召回它之前，如果我们没了航天飞机，探索彗星会困难得多。或许我们不该降落在彗星的背阴面……

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Suppose one of us remained in the shuttle to keep it warm and continue monitoring the surface.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：设若我们之中有一个人留在航天飞机里，负责维持温度，并继续监测表面情况。

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: This would be wise, I think, Clary. If you don’t mind waiting here with it, Poke and I can continue to investigate the surface.
spirals.zh: 派伊：我认为这很明智，克莱瑞。如果你不介意在这里和它一起等待，珀克和我可以继续调查表面。

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: I fear our situation may be dire:
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：恐怕我们的处境可能十分严峻：

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Poke, Pye and I landed here on this comet not long after its arrival in this star system. Our shuttle’s equipment heard strange energy readings coming from somewhere beneath the surface.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：这颗彗星抵达这个星系后不久，派伊、珀克和我就在这里着陆了。我们的航天飞机设备侦测到，从地表下方某处传来了奇怪的能量读数。

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Pye and Poke were able to locate a fissure in the ice on the comet's sunward side, and they descended inside to investigate the source of the readings.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：派伊和珀克在彗星向阳面的冰层上找到了一道裂隙，随后深入其中，调查读数的来源。

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: But… Pye and my sister have been gone for a long time now. They haven't contacted me since descending below the surface, either.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：可是……派伊和我的姐妹（珀克）已经离开很久了。自从深入地表以下之后，她们也没有再联系过我。

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Should I leave the shuttle to look for them? I want to follow protocol, but I don't know what I'll do if they aren't well…
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：我应该离开航天飞机去找她们吗？我想遵守规程，但如果她们出了事，我不知道自己会怎么办……

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Poke… Pye… Come back to me safely, my friends.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：珀克……派伊……平安回到我身边吧，我的朋友们。

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: I’m receiving much stronger energy readings now that we’re beneath the crust. Whatever it is must lie somewhere below, closer to the comet’s center. And I’m starting to think it’s more dangerous than we realized.
spirals.zh: 派伊：现在我们已经来到地壳之下，接收到的能量读数强烈得多了。不管那是什么，一定就在下方某处，更靠近彗星的中心。而且我开始觉得，它比我们原先意识到的还要危险。

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Clary, can you hear us?
spirals.zh: 派伊：克莱瑞，你能听见我们吗？

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: Yes, but your voices are faint. I fear we will lose communication entirely if you continue any deeper.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：能，但你们的声音很微弱。恐怕你们要是继续深入，我们就会彻底失去联系。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Keep the shuttle warm for us, Clary. We’ll return the moment we identify the source of the energy readings!
spirals.zh: 珀克：克莱瑞，替我们保持航天飞机的温度。我们一确认能量读数的源头，就立刻回来！

spirals.speaker: CLARY
spirals.text: I understand, but… Be cautious, both of you.
spirals.zh: 克莱瑞：我明白，但是……你们两个，一定要小心。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: The spherical stone casing here seems to be the source of the energy readings… No, rather, the source is what’s within the stone. I’m detecting some form of exotic matter.
spirals.zh: 珀克：这里这个球形岩石壳体似乎就是能量读数的源头……不，更准确地说，源头是石头里面的东西。我检测到了某种奇异物质。

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: The stone is *muting* our energy readings; they should be ten times what we’re seeing, at least.
spirals.zh: 派伊：这层岩壳正在削弱我们的能量读数；真实读数至少应该是现在的十倍。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Pye, I don’t think we want this matter interacting with us. As far as I can tell, direct contact with it would almost certainly be fatal.
spirals.zh: 珀克：派伊，我觉得我们不会想让这种物质接触我们。据我判断，直接暴露在它之下几乎必定会致命。

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: I’ve never encountered anything like this casing, but it’s all that’s protecting us from what’s inside. Worse still, this matter is disturbingly volatile.
spirals.zh: 派伊：我从未见过像这样的岩石壳体，但它却是唯一将我们与内容物隔开的屏障。更糟的是，这种物质不稳定得令人不安。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: ...Pye. Whatever the matter inside this stone casing is, it’s more than just profoundly unstable; it’s under tonnes of pressure. Look at this density scan. I’ve never seen *anything* this tightly compacted before! What *is* this?
spirals.zh: 珀克：……派伊。不管这个岩石壳体里的物质是什么，它不只是极度不稳定而已；它还承受着数以吨计的压力。看这份密度扫描。我从没见过任何被压缩得这么紧密的东西！这究竟是什么？

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: This is orders of magnitude worse than I’d imagined. If this stone were to rupture, the lethal matter within would rapidly expand, completely blanketing this star system almost instantaneously. And the pressure is building as the comet approaches the sun...
spirals.zh: 派伊：这比我想象的还要糟糕好几个数量级。如果这块石头破裂，里面的致命物质就会迅速膨胀，几乎在一瞬间完全笼罩整个星系。而且随着彗星接近这个星系，压力还在继续升高……

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: Return to the shuttle, right now! The rest of our friends need to know they’re in terrible danger. Leave your equipment and run!
spirals.zh: 派伊：立刻回航天飞机去！其他朋友必须知道自己正处在极度危险之中。丢下设备，快跑！

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: What are you doing, Pye?!
spirals.zh: 珀克：你在做什么，派伊？！

spirals.speaker: PYE
spirals.text: The more we know about this alien matter, the better our chances of survival. I will learn what I can here. Go warn the others; maybe they can construct shelter somehow. ...*Now*, Poke!
spirals.zh: 派伊：我们越了解这种异星物质，幸存的机会就越大。我来尽力把它弄明白。快去，去警告其他人；也许大家还能设法建造庇护所。……走啊，珀克！

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Welcome to the White Hole Station! If you fell through the black hole by accident (don't worry, you aren’t the first), this warp tower can return you to Brittle Hollow.
spirals.zh: 珀克：欢迎来到白洞站！如果你不小心掉进了黑洞（别担心，你不是第一个），这座跃迁塔可以把你送回碎空星。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Every warp tower is tuned to a specific astral body. A tower's warp can only be used during the brief window when the tower is aligned with its corresponding astral body (in this case, Brittle Hollow).
spirals.zh: 珀克：每座挪麦跃迁塔都与某一特定天体匹配。珀克：每座跃迁塔都与某一特定天体匹配。只有在对准对应天体的短暂时间内，跃迁塔才能执行跃迁（这座塔对应的是碎空星）。
spirals.zh_key: POKE: Every warp tower is tuned to a specific astral body. A tower's warp can only be used during the brief window when the tower is aligned with its corresponding astral body (in this case, Brittle Hollow).

spirals.text: You must be standing on the warp platform on the floor during this alignment to be warped.
spirals.zh: 要进行跃迁，你必须在对准时站在地上的跃迁平台上。
spirals.zh_key: You must be standing on the warp platform on the floor during this alignment to be warped.

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: If you look up while the station is rotating, you can see the alignment happens when the astral body is directly overhead.
spirals.zh: 珀克：如果在白洞站旋转时向上看，你可以看到对准的过程，那时天体会在你的正上方。
spirals.zh_key: POKE: If you look up while the station is rotating, you can see the alignment happens when the astral body is directly overhead.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: Our escape pod crashed as we tried to flee this place, destroying our movement and communication abilities in the process.
spirals.zh: 塞卡：我们想要逃离这个地方，结果逃生舱坠毁了，我们丧失了移动和通讯能力。
spirals.zh_key: SECCA: Our escape pod crashed as we tried to flee this place, destroying our movement and communication capabilities in the process.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: We’ve held out for as long as we could here, but this pod’s supply of breathable air is nearly depleted, and the anglerfish attack more and more frequently.
spirals.zh: 塞卡：我们会在这里尽量坚持下去，不过逃生舱的空气补给即将耗尽，安康鱼的进攻也变得越来越频繁。
spirals.zh_key: SECCA: We’ve held out as long as we could here, but this pod’s supply of breathable air is nearly depleted, and the anglerfish attack more and more frequently.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: Our best chance at survival is to return to the Vessel to either repair the damage, or, more probably, await rescue.
spirals.zh: 塞卡：只有回到飞船那里，把它修好；或者更有可能是在那里等待救援，这样我们活下来的希望才最大。
spirals.zh_key: SECCA: Our best chance at survival is to return to the Vessel to either repair the damage or, more probably, await rescue.

spirals.speaker: ESCALL
spirals.text: Secca, is the message finished? The Vessel’s beacon is already growing fainter; it will be gone in a matter of hours. We need to leave here, quickly.
spirals.zh: 艾斯科尔：塞卡，消息结束了吗？飞船的信标已经开始减弱了，不出几个小时它就会消失。我们得尽快离开这里。
spirals.zh_key: ESCALL: Secca, is the message finished? The Vessel’s beacon is already growing fainter; it will be gone in a matter of hours. We need to leave here, quickly.

spirals.speaker: DIN
spirals.text: There is a new problem: our equipment is detecting two distinct beacons from the Vessel.
spirals.zh: 迪恩：有一个新的问题：我们的设备在两个不同的地方检测到了飞船发出的信标。
spirals.zh_key: DIN: There is a new problem: Our equipment is detecting two distinct beacons from the Vessel.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: But it isn’t possible for the Vessel to be in two different locations at the same time.
spirals.zh: 塞卡：可是飞船不可能同时出现在两个地方啊。
spirals.zh_key: SECCA: But it isn’t possible for the Vessel to be in two different locations at the same time.

spirals.speaker: DIN
spirals.text: I agree, but the beacons are exactly identical to each other. Perhaps if I had more time-
spirals.zh: 迪恩：我同意，但这两个信标是完全相同的。也许再给我一点时间的话……
spirals.zh_key: DIN: I agree, but the beacons are exactly identical to each other. Perhaps if I had more time —

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: We’re nearly out of time already, Din; the Vessel’s beacon is quickly fading. Soon, it will be gone, and we will be lost.
spirals.zh: 塞卡：我们已经快没时间了，迪恩；飞船的信标正在迅速衰减。很快它就会消失，到时候我们就找不到路了。
spirals.zh_key: SECCA: We’re nearly out of time already, Din; the Vessel’s beacon is quickly fading. Soon, it will be gone, and we will be lost.

spirals.speaker: ESCALL
spirals.text: We will follow the beacon whose source is closest to us.
spirals.zh: 艾斯科尔：我们要跟着信标源最近的那个信标走。
spirals.zh_key: ESCALL: We will follow the beacon whose source is nearest to us.

spirals.speaker: DIN
spirals.text: But suppose that beacon is false!
spirals.zh: 迪恩：但万一那个信标是假的呢！
spirals.zh_key: DIN: But suppose that beacon is false!

spirals.speaker: ESCALL
spirals.text: We likely don’t have enough air to reach the farther of the two beacons, Din. The decision is made for us.
spirals.zh: 艾斯科尔：我们不大可能有足够的空气去寻找比较远的那个信标，迪恩。我们别无选择。
spirals.zh_key: ESCALL: We likely don’t have enough air to reach the farther of the two beacons, Din. The decision is made for us.

spirals.speaker: ESCALL
spirals.text: We’ll leave a trail of lights as we go. There’s still a chance someone could hear our escape pod’s distress signal.
spirals.zh: 艾斯科尔：我们一边走一边在路上留下发光路标。别人依然有可能会收到我们的逃生舱发出来的信号。
spirals.zh_key: ESCALL: We’ll leave a trail of lights as we go. There’s still a chance someone could hear our escape pod’s distress signal.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: To any who come here searching for us: we followed one of the two beacons from the Vessel to this place, but now can go no further.
spirals.zh: 塞卡：给来找我们的人：我们跟着飞船发出的两个信标之一来到了这个地方，但现在我们没法继续前进了。
spirals.zh_key: SECCA: To any who come here searching for us: We followed one of the two beacons from the Vessel to this place, but now can go no further.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: It’s almost too faint to hear now, but the Vessel’s beacon is still faintly emitting from within this thorny seed. Yet the opening is too small for a single Nomai to fit through, so our escape pod couldn’t have flown through here.
spirals.zh: 塞卡：信号现在已经快接收不到了，但是飞船的信标还在从这个带刺的种子里向外进行微弱的发射。开口太小，就连一个挪麦人都钻不过去，所以我们的逃生舱没办法飞进去。
spirals.zh_key: SECCA: It’s almost too faint to hear now, but the Vessel’s beacon is still faintly emitting from within this thorny seed. Yet the opening is too small for even a single Nomai to fit through it, so our escape pod couldn’t have flown through here.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: I don’t understand how this could be possible, but this gruesome place seems able to manipulate space itself; maybe this was our undoing.
spirals.zh: 塞卡：我不明白这怎么可能，不过这个可怕的地方貌似能够操控空间；也许这就是我们末日。
spirals.zh_key: SECCA: I don’t understand how this could be possible, but this gruesome place seems able to manipulate space itself; maybe this was our undoing.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: To be so close to the location of the Vessel and still so far is… difficult. Worse, the Vessel’s beacon is dying; soon, we will be unable to hear it.
spirals.zh: 塞卡：飞船的位置就在眼前，可要找到它却……如此困难。更糟糕的是，飞船的信标正在衰减；很快我们就要接收不到信号了。
spirals.zh_key: SECCA: To be so close to the location of the Vessel and still so far is... difficult. Worse, the Vessel’s beacon is dying; soon, we will be unable to hear it.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: There is nothing we can do now but try to perhaps find a way inside, or at least attempt to comprehend why this happened.
spirals.zh: 塞卡：现在我们什么都做不了，只能试着看看能不能想办法进去，或者至少弄清楚为什么会发生这样的事情。
spirals.zh_key: SECCA: There is nothing we can do now but try to perhaps find a way inside, or at least attempt to comprehend why this happened.

spirals.speaker: SECCA
spirals.text: My dearest hope is that the other escape pods were able to reach relative safety.
spirals.zh: 塞卡：我最大的愿望就是其它逃生舱落到了相对安全的地方。
spirals.zh_key: SECCA: My dearest hope is that the other escape pods were able to reach relative safety.

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: I’m recording now - I’ve never encountered anything like this! The signal the Vessel is receiving seems to be *older than the universe itself*!
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：我正在做记录，我从没见过这样的事情！飞船收到的信号貌似比宇宙本身还要古老！
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: I’m recording now — I’ve never encountered anything like this! The signal the Vessel is receiving appears to be older than the universe itself!

spirals.speaker: ESCALL
spirals.text: This is our first contact with anything of this nature. Everyone, prepare to warp immediately!
spirals.zh: 艾斯科尔：这是我们第一次接触到这种情况。所有人，准备立刻跃迁！
spirals.zh_key: ESCALL: This is our first contact with anything of this nature. Everyone, prepare to warp immediately!

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: Escall, wait! I need more time to send an outgoing message! Shouldn’t we tell another clan where we’re going?
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：艾斯科尔，等等，我需要一点时间来向外发送消息！难道我们不该把自己的目的地告诉其他家族吗？
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: Escall, wait, I need more time to send an outgoing message! Shouldn’t we tell another clan where we’re going?

spirals.speaker: ESCALL
spirals.text: We can send the message on arrival. This extraordinary signal appeared suddenly; it may disappear just as quickly, and we can’t lose a discovery this incredible! Focus on preparing for the warp, instead.
spirals.zh: 艾斯科尔：消息可以在我们抵达后再发。这个非同寻常的信号是突然出现的；它可能也会瞬间消失，我们不能失去如此重大的发现！还是集中精神为跃迁做好准备吧。
spirals.zh_key: ESCALL: We can send the message upon our arrival. This extraordinary signal appeared suddenly; it may disappear just as quickly, and we can’t lose a discovery this incredible! Focus on preparing for the warp, instead.

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: I understand!
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：我明白了！
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: I understand!

spirals.speaker: ESCALL
spirals.text: Annona, is the Vessel ready to warp to the signal’s approximate coordinates?
spirals.zh: 艾斯科尔：安诺纳，飞船准备好跃迁到信号的大致坐标上了吗？
spirals.zh_key: ESCALL: Annona, is the Vessel ready to warp to the signal’s approximate coordinates?

spirals.speaker: ANNONA
spirals.text: The warp core is powered, but this will be a significant jump. Afterward, we’ll need time to recharge the core.
spirals.zh: 安诺纳：跃迁核心充能完毕，但这次跃迁的距离十分遥远。我们之后需要花时间为核心重新充能。
spirals.zh_key: ANNONA: The warp core is powered, but this will be a significant jump. Afterward, we’ll need time to recharge the core.

spirals.speaker: ESCALL
spirals.text: That shouldn’t create a problem, provided we arrive at or near the signal’s source. Everyone, we’re ready to warp!
spirals.zh: 艾斯科尔：只要我们能够抵达信号源的位置或是附近，那就应该不成问题。所有人，我们准备跃迁！
spirals.zh_key: ESCALL: That shouldn’t create a problem, provided we arrive at or near the signal’s source. Everyone, we’re ready to warp!

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: This is Escall’s Vessel; something went badly wrong during our warp, and our Vessel is mortally wounded. We need help as quickly as possible!
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：这里是艾斯科尔的飞船；我们的跃迁出了大问题，我们的飞船遭受严重损伤。我们需要尽快得到帮助！
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: This is Escall’s Vessel; something went badly wrong during our warp, and our Vessel is mortally wounded. We need help as quickly as possible!

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: Our Vessel appears to have… has it *fused* with the local environment, somehow? There are vines that are now part of the Vessel! It’s been torn apart from inside itself!
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：我们的飞船好像……好像和当地环境融合在了一起？如今藤蔓也变成了飞船的一部分！它在内部拆卸自己！
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: Our Vessel appears to have... has it fused with the local environment, somehow? There are vines that are now part of the Vessel! It’s been torn apart from inside itself!

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: We… we are abandoning our Vessel. Any Nomai clans or spaceflight-capable species receiving, I implore you, we need your help!
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：我们……我们要放弃飞船了。收到这个消息的挪麦家族，或是具有太空航行能力的种族，我恳请你们，我们需要你们的帮助！
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: We... we are abandoning our Vessel. Any Nomai clans or spaceflight-capable species receiving this message, I implore you, we need your help!

spirals.speaker: FILIX
spirals.text: Is this broken? Can anyone hear me? Our Vessel is dying! We need immediate assistance!
spirals.zh: 费利克斯：这东西坏了吗？有人能听见吗？我们的飞船正在死亡！我们急需援助！
spirals.zh_key: FILIX: Is this broken? Can anyone hear me? Our Vessel is dying! We need immediate assistance!

spirals.speaker: CANNA
spirals.text: To any Nomai Clans whose Vessels can hear this message:
spirals.zh: 卡纳：所有能够收到这个消息的挪麦家族飞船注意：
spirals.zh_key: CANNA: To any Nomai clans whose Vessels can hear this message:

spirals.speaker: CANNA
spirals.text: It’s clear the universe is dying. There are fewer and fewer resources and safe places within space now, so my clan and I believe the best option is for all of our clans to stay together.
spirals.zh: 卡纳：很明显，这个宇宙正在死亡。太空里安全的地方越来越少，资源也是一样。因此我的家族和我认为，最好的办法就是让所有的家族都团结在一起。
spirals.zh_key: CANNA: It’s clear the universe is dying. There are fewer and fewer resources and safe places within space now, so my clan and I believe the best option is for all of our clans to stay together.

spirals.speaker: CANNA
spirals.text: If you can reach the Gloaming Galaxy, we’ve found that Blackrock’s suns are fairly stable, and life in this star system is (comparatively) thriving. We live in relative safety.
spirals.zh: 卡纳：如果你能够前往暮色银河那就最好，我们已经发现黑石星系的太阳比较稳定，这个星系的生命比较起来还算是繁荣。在这里生活，我们可以稍微安全一些。
spirals.zh_key: CANNA: If you can reach the Gloaming Galaxy, we’ve found that Blackrock’s suns are fairly stable, and life in this star system is (comparatively) thriving. We live in relative safety.

spirals.speaker: BROMI
spirals.text: Canna, we’re making our way to you.
spirals.zh: 布洛密：卡纳，我们正在朝你那里进发。
spirals.zh_key: BROMI: Canna, we’re making our way to you.

spirals.speaker: CANNA
spirals.text: Has anyone heard from Neem? His clan was on its way to our Vessel, but they never arrived, and he hasn’t sent any messages. I’m beginning to worry.
spirals.zh: 卡纳：有尼姆的消息？他的家族正在朝我们的飞船前进，但一直没能抵达。而且他也没有发来任何消息。我开始有点担心了。
spirals.zh_key: CANNA: Has anyone heard from Neem? His clan was on its way to our Vessel, but they never arrived, and he hasn’t sent any messages. I’m beginning to worry.

spirals.speaker: BROMI
spirals.text: That *is* unsettling. It reminds me of that old myth my grandfather used to tell, the Disappearance of Escall.
spirals.zh: 布洛密：那可真是不妙啊。我想起了祖父以前常常挂在嘴边的一个古老传说：艾斯科尔的失踪。
spirals.zh_key: BROMI: That is unsettling. It reminds me of that old myth my grandfather used to tell, the Disappearance of Escall.

spirals.speaker: CLEM
spirals.text: I remember hearing that story as a child! One day, Escall’s Vessel simply stopped responding. The other clans searched and searched, but found no trace. It was as if their missing friends had warped out of existence.
spirals.zh: 克莱姆：我记得小时候听过这个故事！有一天，艾斯科尔的飞船突然没了消息。其他家族找了又找，可是一无所获。仿佛他们的朋友们就这样彻底消失不见了。
spirals.zh_key: CLEM: I remember hearing that story as a child! One day, Escall’s Vessel simply stopped responding. The other clans searched and searched, but found no trace. It was as if their missing friends had warped out of existence.

spirals.speaker: HYSSOP
spirals.text: That’s no myth, friends: Escall’s clan existed, and their story was real.
spirals.zh: 希索普：那可不是什么传说，朋友们。艾斯科尔家族曾经存在过，他们的故事也是真的。
spirals.zh_key: HYSSOP: That’s no myth, friends; Escall’s clan existed, and their story was real.

spirals.speaker: BROMI
spirals.text: What a curious event to have passed into myth! Our ancestors’ ancestors were told that story when they were young. Are you sure it’s true, Hyssop?
spirals.zh: 布洛密：这样一个离奇的事件，怎么就成了传说呢！那是我们祖先的祖先在小时候听长辈说的故事。你确定这个事情是真的吗，希索普？
spirals.zh_key: BROMI: What a curious event to have passed into myth! Our ancestors’ ancestors were told that story when they were young. Are you sure it’s true, Hyssop?

spirals.speaker: HYSSOP
spirals.text: It was a very long time ago, but yes. My clan’s ancestors searched for Escall’s clan for a long time, but in the end, none of them were ever seen again. (It’s the only time a Vessel has ever disappeared in this way.)
spirals.zh: 希索普：事情已经过去很久了。不过它的确是真的。我们家族的祖先花了很长时间来寻找艾斯科尔家族。但是到了最后，谁都没有再听说过他们的消息。（飞船以这种方式失踪，在我们的历史上这是唯一的一次。）
spirals.zh_key: HYSSOP: It was a very long time ago, but yes. My clan’s ancestors searched for Escall’s clan for a long time, but in the end, none of them were ever seen again. (It’s the only time in our history a Vessel has ever disappeared this way.)

spirals.speaker: NEEM
spirals.text: Hyssop, I hope you aren’t comparing Escall’s story to my clan’s vessel!
spirals.zh: 尼姆：希索普，但愿你不是在拿艾斯科尔的故事和我们家族的飞船打比方！
spirals.zh_key: NEEM: Hyssop, I hope you aren’t comparing Escall’s story to my clan’s Vessel!

spirals.speaker: CLEM
spirals.text: Neem, my friend! We feared you were gone!
spirals.zh: 克莱姆：尼姆，我的朋友！我们还担心你是不是失踪了呢！
spirals.zh_key: CLEM: Neem, my friend! We feared you were gone!

spirals.speaker: NEEM
spirals.text: Not yet, we aren’t, but nearly. We found trouble during our warp: the triple suns of the Bright Spark star system exploded, and it was only a lucky coincidence we weren’t caught in the blast. We’ll meet you soon, Canna!
spirals.zh: 尼姆：这倒是没有，不过就差一点。我们在跃迁的时候遇到了麻烦：闪耀火花星系的三颗太阳爆发了。算我们走运，这才没被卷进去。我们待会儿见，卡纳！
spirals.zh_key: NEEM: Not yet, we aren’t, but nearly. We found trouble during our warp: The triple suns of the Bright Spark star system exploded, and it was only a lucky coincidence we weren’t caught in the blast. We’ll meet you soon, Canna!

spirals.speaker: CANNA
spirals.text: I’m relieved your clan is safe, Neem! It’s good to hear your words. Any clan nearby, remember to be extremely cautious of potentially unstable stars (which is most of them, now).
spirals.zh: 卡纳：你的家族没事可真是太好了，尼姆！很高兴能够收到你的消息。附近所有的飞船，请多加小心可能出现的不稳定恒星。就目前而言，大部分恒星都不稳定。
spirals.zh_key: CANNA: I’m relieved your clan is safe, Neem! It’s good to hear your words. Any Vessels nearby, remember to be extremely cautious of potentially unstable stars (which is most of them, now).
